ap_supply_lt_n.name: Emergency Sanity Booster
ap_supply_lt_n.decoDesc: A moderate dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. The developer seemed to have acquired a secret formula from some strange documents that multiplied the amount of sugar within this specific preparation.

item_collection_frag.name: Æther Manifest Shard
item_collection_frag.decoDesc: A fragment of an object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.

item_port_dismantler_1.name: Separating Unit
item_port_dismantler_1.decoDesc: Eighty percent of those who first heard the story of the separating unit simply refused to believe this fact: The design of this facility was inspired by large UWST disassembling stations for sawing and cutting apart Aggeloi carcasses.

ap_supply_lt_weekly.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
ap_supply_lt_weekly.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

item_weekraid_collection_5_1_d.name: Classified: Security Bureau Staff
item_weekraid_collection_5_1_d.decoDesc: Classified records about someone working in the UWST Security Bureau. The attached photograph looks extremely discomforting, as though someone took the features of different people and pieced them together to create a new face.

business_card_topic_bp_1_0.name: New Horizons
business_card_topic_bp_1_0.decoDesc: Go forth. A new, boundless world awaits.

item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_hand_02.name: Swordmancer TAC Fists
item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_hand_02.decoDesc:
One of the products marketed by the Bureau of Swordmancers in its early days. 
Product validation for the tactical gauntlets include this particular assessment: "Make a 24-fold flower with a sheet of Xuan paper while wearing these gauntlets."

business_card_topic_chr_0009_azrila.name: The Bastion Never Breached
business_card_topic_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Red hot steel and solid blood were the brick and mortar of the northern bastions. The North is not her nightmare. It is merely her next destination.

item_charpotentialup_chr_9000_endmin.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_9000_endmin.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_pic_3_chr_0011_seraph.name: Sincerity of Faith
item_pic_3_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: The Law, the Signs, the Logic, and the Algorithms — The faithful cleric is fully indulged in all them.

business_card_topic_chr_0013_aglina.name: Let's Flip the World
business_card_topic_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: Turn your vision upside down and you'll see different views, experience different moods, and become a different you. Oh my, the world has become completely new.

business_card_topic_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Heart of Youth
business_card_topic_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: Like a block of natural jade, he will endure the chiseling and retain his purity of heart.

item_gift_tundra_6.name: Simonch Shawl
item_gift_tundra_6.decoDesc: A shawl woven from soft, fine fibers. The craftmakers of Simonch treat these shawls as a symbol of friendship. They would make wonderful gifts for your friends.

business_card_topic_chr_0016_laevat.name: An Invite to the Melting Fire
business_card_topic_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: Accompany her through long nights without memories. Fight with her and burn the dark, nightmarish enemies. Stand with her as she lights fires to illuminate future journeys.

gem_claym_0010_42.name: Pure Essence
gem_claym_0010_42.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as pure.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.name: Distorted Key
item_mission_sm1l2m2_key.decoDesc: A common key picked up in a mining tunnel, but it has been so malformed that it can no longer be used.

item_regionbuff_wuling_4_1.name: Outdoors Expert
item_regionbuff_wuling_4_1.decoDesc: Having searched high and low for Aurylenes, you now know every blade of grass and every lump of ore in this region. You have become an expert of the natural wilderness.

business_card_topic_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Win-Win!
business_card_topic_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: Bright-colored coatings, an upbeat soundtrack, and a satisfied smile of victory... She has recorded every joyous moment and now she's sharing them with you.

business_card_topic_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Aspiration
business_card_topic_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: Flowers blooming on cold, hard rocks ... barren lands teeming with life and warmth ... and idyllic songs humming by our ears... Professor, this isn't just a dream, right?

business_card_topic_chr_0026_lastrite.name: First Rime to Bloom
business_card_topic_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: She has many unanswered questions, and many difficulties not yet overcome. Nevertheless, she will complete all of your assignments and bring back the smiles on everyone's faces.

wpn_funnel_0006.name: Opus: Etch Figure
wpn_funnel_0006.decoDesc: A contracted product from Portable Æthertech Labs. Features metal components hand-engraved by cræft-adepts to create etch figures that match those of the tillite parts. The result is an Arts unit with unique Arts casting circuitry.

business_card_topic_chr_0029_pograni.name: Checkmate
business_card_topic_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: The smoke of ruin still lingered. Numerous pieces, living and dead, fell off the ponderous corpse. His blade served as the support of his body, his steel oath, and his vigil — And then he made his move. Checkmate.

item_formu_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_01.name: AIC Heavy Plate
item_formu_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: AIC Heavy Plate.

item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_03.name: Mordvolt Insulation Battery
item_equip_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_03.decoDesc:
An extremely durable battery. 
In Talos-II, emergency repair work in Blighted conditions is an extremely dangerous job. Hence, workers must undergo strict training based on special standards before they are allowed to use batteries in such environments.

business_card_topic_normal_2.name: Initial Link
business_card_topic_normal_2.decoDesc: A syringe, a flower, and an echo of gratitude. You extend your hand and relink the lands.

gem_funnel_0001_663.name: Flawless Essence
gem_funnel_0001_663.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_formu_t4_suit_poise01_edc_02.name: Æthertech Stabilizer
item_formu_t4_suit_poise01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Æthertech Stabilizer.

business_card_topic_normal_3.name: Protocol Procession
business_card_topic_normal_3.decoDesc: The Protocol has been activated. The process of life is moving forward. May you join us in our march forward.

chr_0002_endminm.name: The Endministrator
chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc:
Endministrator's employment contract. 
"You might be the Endministrator, but protocol and directive have necessitated these formalities..."

chr_0003_endminf.name: The Endministrator
chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc:
Endministrator's employment contract. 
"You might be the Endministrator, but protocol and directive have necessitated these formalities..."

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_01.name: Aburrey UV Lamp
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Novel protective equipment modified to suit the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
The engineers worked through the night to slap on mods when work at Aburrey Quarry suddenly involved excavation and digging. This armor now features eyesight and hearing protection.

chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica
chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc:
Perlica's employment contract. 
"Our Supervisor might be very young, yet she has conveyed the Endfield vision to everyone."

chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu
chr_0005_chen.decoDesc:
Chen Qianyu's employment contract. 
"Let me check how many times Operator Chen challenged other Endfielders to a spar... Uh... Oh dear... She probably figured out a new move and wanted to show everyone."

item_shot_sticker_1.name: Sticker: Endfield
item_shot_sticker_1.decoDesc: This sticker made it to the most recommended list amongst Endfield photography enthusiasts. Our home and fount of pride. Our Endfield Industries.

chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard
chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc:
Wulfgard's employment contract. 
"Trust this skilled hunter of the Pack to help you deal with frontiersmates and Landbreakers."

item_liquid_water.name: Clean Water
item_liquid_water.decoDesc: It has always been the source of life.

item_port_soil_sp_4.name: Amber Rice Plot
item_port_soil_sp_4.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Amber Rice. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight
chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc:
Arclight's employment contract. 
"I really want to know how Operator Arclight understands this world as a scabhta of the Hannabit Circuit... Talking with her feels quite ... exhausting."

chr_0009_azrila.name: Ember
chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc:
Ember's employment contract. 
"Though ever the razor blade and ferric bastion, her Crusade has yet to end."

item_preset_gem_5_ult.name: Flawless Essence: Twilight
item_preset_gem_5_ult.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_rubbishKing_gift2.name: Norbert's Brand New Collection
item_rubbishKing_gift2.decoDesc:
Mr. Norbert gave you yet another souvenir as a token of his gratitude. 
This object looks like a camera but surprisingly lacks the ability to take photographs. 
What exactly is it? Best not ask Mr. Norbert because the Junkyard Lord probably doesn't know either.

chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi
chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc:
Xaihi's employment contract. 
"I have no choice but to endorse Xaihi's exceptional abilities in living together with various mechanical contraptions. However, I do not understand why she wants a logic module of the same model I'm using."

chr_0012_avywen.name: Avywenna
chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc:
Avywenna's employment contract. 
"She is incredibly motivated and passionate... Her communication skills are impeccable... Surprising enough, she also has the fighting abilities to match..."

item_agmelee_1_moss_1_lbmob_1_1.name: Meaty Buckflower Stew
item_agmelee_1_moss_1_lbmob_1_1.decoDesc: Despite the absolute lack of meat, this dish has a rich, hearty taste. Aggagrit seasoning may indeed revolutionize certain approaches to the culinary arts.

item_char_skill_specialize_5.name: Triphasic Nanoflake
item_char_skill_specialize_5.decoDesc: A device that is extremely sensitive to ambient Originium. It can boost Originium sensitivity of all weapons and devices within a significantly large area. The Triphasic Nanoflake is a key component for containing and storing the Arts, and offers better performance in non-realspace environments compared to the older Bipolar Nanoflakes.

item_fbottle_glass_grass_1.name: Amethyst Bottle
item_fbottle_glass_grass_1.decoDesc: Amethyst bottles are being phased out from markets in the Civilization Band due to its fragility, weight, and Blight resistance.

chr_0013_aglina.name: Gilberta
chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc:
Gilberta's employment contract. 
"Complex hues of color, infinite possibilities, plus a dash of sweetness."

item_formu_t3_suit_atk01_edc_02.name: Aburrey Auditory Chip
item_formu_t3_suit_atk01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Aburrey Auditory Chip.

chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowshine
chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc:
Snowshine's employment contract. 
"Well, at least little miss reliable Snowshine is in the SAR team." Many operators will tell themselves this when receiving missions in extreme environments."

chr_0015_lifeng.name: Lifeng
chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc:
Lifeng's employment contract. 
"Simple, sincere, understanding... I got a sudden feeling that Lifeng might have completed a few more errands while I'm writing this down."

chr_0016_laevat.name: Laevatain
chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc:
Laevatain's employment contract. 
"Do not fear the fire... Simply walk with her to create lasting moments together."

item_weekraid_tech_2_2.name: Container Expansion Chip 2
item_weekraid_tech_2_2.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne
chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc:
Yvonne's employment contract. 
"Her unique approach and modus operandi are proof of her ingenuity. She always offers the most unique views regarding the directions of research projects or the strengths of her colleagues."

item_equip_t3_suit_str01_edc_01.name: Armored MSGR Gyro T1
item_equip_t3_suit_str01_edc_01.decoDesc:
An intricate fidget toy. 
Results from a trustworthy poll revealed that about 80% of messengers would modify this toy into a miniature dart grenade.

chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan
chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc:
Da Pan's employment contract. 
"What about Operator Da Pan's friendly and easy-going nature? He probably acquired them from his rich career experiences: chef, small business proprietor, electrician, carpenter, chauffeur... Suffice to say, it is quite extensive."

item_bottled_grass2spc_2.name: Yazhen Spray [L]
item_bottled_grass2spc_2.decoDesc: A simple spray made with a filling unit. Administer orally if necessary.

chr_0019_karin.name: Akekuri
chr_0019_karin.decoDesc:
Akekuri's employment contract. 
"More than just a top graduate of a business school who recommended herself to Endfield Industries. She is an idealist driven by fiery passion."

item_formu_t3_suit_usp01_edc_03.name: Catastrophe Filter
item_formu_t3_suit_usp01_edc_03.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Catastrophe Filter.

chr_0020_meurs.name: Catcher
chr_0020_meurs.decoDesc:
Catcher's employment contract. 
"Did you just tell me that Mr. Catcher is gonna be part of this operation? Woot! Awesome! Now I can breathe easy."

chr_0021_whiten.name: Estella
chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc:
Estella's employment contract. 
"You can trust Estella on anything EXCEPT life. And don't try any of the 'yummies' she might recommend. It's for your own good."

chr_0022_bounda.name: Fluorite
chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc:
Fluorite's employment contract. 
"Actually, none of the operators felt that she deliberately committed the mischief. That's where things get really complicated."

chr_0023_antal.name: Antal
chr_0023_antal.decoDesc:
Antal's employment contract. 
"Operator Antal is indeed a suitable teammate, given his talents in the Originium Arts... But Kjersch is a very cold place. His bad jokes will only make it worse."

item_formu_t3_suit_atk01_edc_05.name: Aburrey Sensor Chip
item_formu_t3_suit_atk01_edc_05.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Aburrey Sensor Chip.

chr_0024_deepfin.name: Alesh
chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc:

"If you have time, you can go angling with him and visit his fin stall for a rich selection of live fins, fresh intel, or the next lucky person he might catch for that day."

chr_0025_ardelia.name: Ardelia
chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc:
Ardelia's employment contract. 
"Follow her light, gentle strides, listen to the murmurs of the land, and heal the suffering and pain of this planet."

item_paper_002_01.name: Bloodied Note I
item_paper_002_01.decoDesc:
Too many nosy people around, so I wrote it down on paper. Burn it when you're done reading. 
The Landbreakers took our camp, supplies, and cash. I sneaked over there and saw what they did. The LB scum took apart everything. Even mama's kitchen sink! 
I got a plan to deal with these greedy scab eaters.
We'll leave a few obvious and subtle clues, graffiti, and letters about secret loot stashes that don't exist. Some of the LBs are bound to bite the bait and do their own digging in secret. When that happens, we'll show them what we're made of. 
No one is the eternal prey. And no one is the eternal hunter.

item_003_chips_3.name: Letter from Witte
item_003_chips_3.decoDesc:
Letter from Witte: 
You've been careless. Don't leave important chips lying around like that. Anyways, I took it back to the dorms. You'll find it there.

item_add_endurance.name: Stamina Delimiter
item_add_endurance.decoDesc: The symbol of endurance. If necessary, this conceptual entity can become a brick. If things get even more desperate, life itself becomes a concept as well. The completion of our Tower is at hand.

item_adventureexp.name: Operational EXP
item_adventureexp.decoDesc: A form of experience you earn as you explore Talos-II. Like always, these lands await your discovery, Endministrator.

item_agfly_1_agmelee_1_moss_2_1.name: Cosmo-Melto Jelly
item_agfly_1_agmelee_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: A jelly that people can easily prepare, even in the wildlands. Citromes can be dissolved in a mixture of two different types of aggagrits to create a strange jelly-like material.

item_agmelee_1_sp_2_slimeml_1_1.name: Superhot Slug Gratin
item_agmelee_1_sp_2_slimeml_1_1.decoDesc: A comfort food with comforting heat. It is an ancient legacy passed from one planet to another. It tastes of home.

item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_01.name: AIC Heavy Plate
item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. 
Raising defense performance also leads to massive increases in weight, which also happens to be the biggest issue with this equipment.

item_agrange_1_erhound_1_sp_1_1.name: Jakub's Legacy
item_agrange_1_erhound_1_sp_1_1.decoDesc: Bread with a hardness akin to D64 Steel. The origins can be traced back to the time before the Landbreakers splintered into separate clans. According to the Landbreakers, the legendary warlord Jakub always had this on his dining table.

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_hand_02.name: Eternal Xiranite Gloves T1
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_hand_02.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
...Days passed and the mad Tianshi began to reject any food that "fail to deliver inspirations". After being reduced to skin and bones, he soon disappeared into the wildlands in pursuit of "palatable Xiranite".

item_plant_mushroom_1_2.name: Red Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_2.decoDesc: Ruby boletes with darker hues provide extracts with greater pharmaceutical values. This is the red stage.

item_agrange_1_lbshamman_bottled_1.name: Simple Pain Relief Salve
item_agrange_1_lbshamman_bottled_1.decoDesc: A pain relief salve prepared using Karja's secret formula. The salve is very popular amongst those engaged with heavy manual labor.

item_agrange_1_moss_2_lbmob_1_1.name: Handmade Weirdrop
item_agrange_1_moss_2_lbmob_1_1.decoDesc: A candy with a sad, greenish color. Its preparation might be based on Landbreaker recipes. It tastes like licorice, but with an added dash of tartness.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_edc_01.name: Emergency Comm
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Protective equipment for mining operations. 
Valley IV Safety and Protection Standards dictate that minimum requirements for work protection must comprise a 2-layered protection of (i) a soft, cushioning layer and (ii) hard, rigid protection.

item_puzzle_m1l5.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L5
item_puzzle_m1l5.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_ap_feed_in.name: Sanity Extractor
item_ap_feed_in.decoDesc:
A special auto-extractor.
"Your keen senses shall be fused with your desires to explore this world, and create medicinal sanity supplements that you can hold in reserve."

item_weekraid_collection_4_6_d.name: Specimen: Astronomical Object
item_weekraid_collection_4_6_d.decoDesc: A fragment of an astronomical object sealed in a jar. Though ... the Fifth Child, the youngling, has fractured, it remains unblemished.

item_ap_supply_lt.name: LTO Sanity Syrup
item_ap_supply_lt.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you see double while reading these instructions.

item_weekraid_collection_3_2.name: Classified: Aggelos Forge
item_weekraid_collection_3_2.decoDesc: Classified records about the Aggelos Forge. The document seems to describe an aberrant version of some Originium Science Park experimental product. Artificial Aggeloi is a distant fantasy. Opening the forge only causes squealing pebbles to hop out of it.

item_ap_supply_lt_l.name: Emergency Sanity Concentrate
item_ap_supply_lt_l.decoDesc: A large dose of Sanity syrup contained with an emergency-use package. Its effects are immediate. A list of side-effects, including severe insomnia, have been provided in the user's manual. Good luck!

item_ap_supply_lt_s.name: Emergency Sanity Sample
item_ap_supply_lt_s.decoDesc: A small dose of Sanity syrup sample contained within an emergency-use package. Use this item on time and avoid unnecessary stockpiling to avoid expiration.

item_port_soil_moss_3.name: Sandleaf Plot
item_port_soil_moss_3.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Sandleaves. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_ap_supply_nlt.name: Sanity Syrup
item_ap_supply_nlt.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of restoring sanity. Consider doubling your intake if you're seeing double when reading these instructions.

item_equip_t3_suit_agi01_edc_01.name: Roving MSGR Flashlight T1
item_equip_t3_suit_agi01_edc_01.decoDesc:
A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. 
The sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break open old boxes or containers.

item_ap_take_out.name: Sanity Essence
item_ap_take_out.decoDesc: A very special Sanity potion. There is no need to panic if you experience throat swelling, throat pain, or abdominal discomfort after use. Just drink some warm water to alleviate the said symptoms.

item_book_002_01.name: Real Estate Ad
item_book_002_01.decoDesc:
Enjoy the Koncerdel view! Experience what it truly means to live the life! 
Edge of the new frontier! An investment that will rake in millions! 
100-200 square meters of picturesque scenery with interiors designed by master Hongshan artisans. 
300 mm of reinforced defensive steel (RDS) for a peace of mind against Aggeloi or Ætherside threats. 
1615 New Year Sale. Available while this special discount lasts! Make this dream home yours for a minimum down payment of 10,000! That's JUST 10K!

item_dog_1_slimeml_1_1.name: Stew Meeting
item_dog_1_slimeml_1_1.decoDesc: A basin full of "criminally generous riches". It is obvious that this is prepared with more than one type of meat. Help yourself to a bowl or two. Such normal-looking food is a rarity, considering it was made in a hostile environment.

item_formu_t4_suit_heal01_edc_04.name: LYNX Aegis Injector

item_domain_jinlong_coupon.decoDesc: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all Accordatories shall, while ensuring the unimpeded circulation of Talosian Credit Notes in the civilian economy, maintain commodity stockpiles to cover the issuance of such stock bills, thereby facilitating orderly and effective joint stockpile redistribution under exceptional circumstances.

item_bottled_flower1spc_2.name: Buckpill [L]
item_bottled_flower1spc_2.decoDesc: A bottle of medicinal pills made with crafting. This one offers a larger dosage compared to its basic counterpart.

item_pic_3_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: Having witnessed the focus of her longing, she no longer wishes to stay put. The Protocol was never meant to be cold, unfeeling bindings.

item_bottled_food_2.name: Canned Citrome [B]

item_bottled_grass1spc_1.name: Jincao Tisane
item_bottled_grass1spc_1.decoDesc: A traditional tisane made by brewing a special blend of secret Wuling herbs. The bitter taste will help you recall the saddest and most desperate times of your life.

item_mission_c13_pack2.name: Precision Parts Package

item_bottled_grass1spc_2.name: Jincao Infusion

item_weekraid_key_5_d.name: Axe Armor Fragment
item_weekraid_key_5_d.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This sharp and sturdy horn fragment was dropped off the back of an Axe Armorbeast. Any rock that comes into contact with the fragment would be pulverized to gravel.

item_bottled_insec1_2.name: Arts Tube
item_bottled_insec1_2.decoDesc: A booster packaged in a metallic tube imbued with Originium Arts. The contents activate the user's vitals, heighten the nervous system, and give a huge adrenaline boost.

item_bottled_insec2_2.name: Kunst Tube

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_2.name: Arms OC: Graffiti
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_2.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected a passionate range of colors.

item_formu_t3_suit_wisd01_body_02.name: Mordvolt Insulation Vest T2

item_plant_moss_seed_1.name: Buckflower Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_1.decoDesc: The Buckflower earned its name as it was first found under a natural arch that resembled a bucking, jumping beast.

item_bottled_moss_2_animal_1.name: Bizarro Chili
item_bottled_moss_2_animal_1.decoDesc: A uniquely flavored meat stew made using Anthony's family recipe. A wildland wanderer like Anthony often carried this chili along with him. It reminds him of home and gives him the calories he needs.
