item_levelup_animal_insec2_angles_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_bottled_rec_hp_2.name: Buck Capsule [B]
item_bottled_rec_hp_2.decoDesc: A capsule prepared using the processes of standard pharmaceutical packaging. Endfield Industries once tried to market this but the amount sold barely came to a fraction of the competing Rhodes Island product.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_02.name: Miner Overalls
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_02.decoDesc:
Protective equipment for mining operations. 
Valley IV Safety and Protection Standards dictate that minimum requirements for work protection must comprise a 2-layered protection of (i) a soft, cushioning layer and (ii) hard, rigid protection.

item_bottled_rec_hp_3.name: Buck Capsule [A]
item_bottled_rec_hp_3.decoDesc: A capsule prepared using optimized packaging techniques. This Endfield product was designed for ease-of-use in combat scenarios.

item_bottled_rec_hp_4.name: Yazhen Syringe [C]
item_bottled_rec_hp_4.decoDesc: Can only be administered via subcutaneous injection.

item_levelup_jlebm_corp4_1.name: Smoked Riceball Upgrade
item_levelup_jlebm_corp4_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_hand_01.name: MI Security Gloves
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
These gloves can also be used as a weapon. Product validation includes an assessment for "effectiveness in smashing Aggeloid appendages".

item_formu_t3_suit_wisd01_edc_02.name: Mordvolt Insulation Battery T1
item_formu_t3_suit_wisd01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Mordvolt Insulation Battery T1.

item_formu_t4_suit_atk02_edc_04.name: Type 50 Yinglung Knife
item_formu_t4_suit_atk02_edc_04.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Type 50 Yinglung Knife.

item_weekraid_tech_6_1.name: Fragmented Treatment Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Fragmented Treatment" technology. Though subject to interference exerted by ambient Derangement, it will do its best to keep you alive and safeguard your health.

item_port_battle_turret_1.name: Gun Tower
item_port_battle_turret_1.decoDesc: Once the complex firing mechanism was simplified, it was combined with the logic of automation designs to create this integrated weapon platform. Many frontier outposts and villages used prototypes of this system to defend themselves against dangerous wildlife.

item_equip_t3_suit_str01_body_01.name: Armored MSGR Jacket T1
item_equip_t3_suit_str01_body_01.decoDesc:
A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. 
Scramblers are cheap and effective modes of transport on Talos-II. Messengers would often outfit these bikes with different mods and modules.

item_plant_sp_seed_2.name: Tartpepper Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_2.decoDesc: Tartpepper seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_levelup_ebs_corp2_1.name: Tartpepper Pickle Upgrade
item_levelup_ebs_corp2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_01.name: Roving MSGR Gyro
item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_01.decoDesc:
An intricate fidget toy. 
Results from a trustworthy poll revealed that about 20% of messengers have modified this stress-relief toy into a self-orienting tracker.

item_m1m8_grassSample_1.name: Fluffed Jincao Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_1.decoDesc: A thriving Fluffed Jincao plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_bp_double_reward.name: Sanity Usage Permit
item_bp_double_reward.decoDesc: A permit that instantly consumes massive Sanity. Excessive Sanity depletion is extremely harmful to the human physique. Before you proceed, you'll need to go through a full medical examination from the Medical Division.

item_pic_3_chr_0009_azrila.name: Boundless Crusade
item_pic_3_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: The crusade is the path to the objective. True warriors do not fall until the goal has been fulfilled.

item_quartz_enr_powder.name: Cryston Powder
item_quartz_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Cryston preparation. The container of this material must be properly sealed to prevent "flowing and leaking" of the powdered Cryston.

item_formu_t3_suit_agi01_edc_02.name: Roving MSGR Flashlight T2
item_formu_t3_suit_agi01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Roving MSGR Flashlight T2.

item_prts_nar_col_lv001_63.name: SHOCKING! Anthology of Phantom Signals from the Last Decade!
item_prts_nar_col_lv001_63.decoDesc: SHOCKING! Anthology of Phantom Signals from the Last Decade!: Data added to the Intel Archive.

item_plant_moss_seed_3.name: Sandleaf Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_3.decoDesc: The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. People forced to live in the wildlands had to do everything they could to survive.

item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_body_01.name: Miner Armor
item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_body_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Miner Armor.

item_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_1.name: Mini Honey Slugpudding
item_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: Citrome-flavored pudding with balanced sour and sweet flavors. Bits of aggagrit were added during boiling. Originium Slug extracts were then used to solidify the entire thing. This cloyingly sweet aroma is simply ... magnificent.

item_bp_miner_3.name: Electric Mining Rig Mk II Template

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_body_02.name: LYNX Cuirass
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_body_02.decoDesc: The medics' preferred equipment. People usually refer to combatants wearing the LYNX Cuirass as "Walking Medkits". These lifesavers often stuff every pocket and holder of their armor with emergency medical supplies.

item_domain_tundra_coupon.name: Valley Stock Bill
item_domain_tundra_coupon.decoDesc: Pursuant to relevant provisions of the Band Accord, all signatories shall, in addition to simultaneously guaranteeing that Talosian Credit Notes provide a currency circulation sufficient for the civil economy, guarantee a commodity stockpile sufficient for the agreed-upon supply of such types of allocation orders so as to achieve an orderly and effective joint allocation during extraordinary circumstances.

item_pic_3_chr_0016_laevat.name: 1538°C
item_pic_3_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: 1538°C is the melting point of ferrium, not hers. Feel free to get closer to her if you think you're ready for it.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_1.name: Valley Basic Engraving Kit
item_gemcustomization_tundra_1.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
This kit, however, is very basic and only contains a simple essence. It is incapable of making an accurate engraving for any desired properties.

item_formu_t0_parts_tundra01_body_02.name: Basic PPE
item_formu_t0_parts_tundra01_body_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Basic PPE.

item_regionbuff_wuling_2_2.name: Rested Defensive
item_regionbuff_wuling_2_2.decoDesc: Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to consolidate your fortitude for holding these grounds.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_2.name: Valley Single-Line Engraving Kit Ⅱ
item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_2.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The kit is provided with a guiding lens, allowing it to inscribe a desired engraving on the data module via optical interference.

item_bp_pump_2.name: Acid Resistant Pump Mk II Template

item_weekraid_collection_4_2_d.name: Classified: Cathedral IV
item_weekraid_collection_4_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records about the new cathedral of the Cabal of Tranquility. In some twisted aberrant, massive ruins hidden beneath the surface of Valley IV seized the attention of the Cabal. And thus they raised a new cathedral at that place.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_3.name: Valley Two-Line Engraving Kit
item_gemcustomization_tundra_3.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The engineers spent nearly a decade to come up with this type of engraving kit. It is capable of making a second engraving upon an essence data module.

item_plant_spcstone_1_1.name: Kalkonyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_1.decoDesc: Nyxites are also known as the "ancient mineral" and symbolize an age of destruction of such a scale never witnessed by humanity. They come in various hues.

item_gift_tundra_3.name: Surfing Festival Ticket
item_gift_tundra_3.decoDesc: An entry ticket to the La Fantoma Surfing Festival. Do not forget to bring your own surfing board when you head over to the competition.

item_char_break_stage_3_4.name: Protoset
item_char_break_stage_3_4.decoDesc: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced data etching processes. Often used with other devices to effectively alleviate physical fatigue of operators during training.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_1.name: Ankhorilling Kitchenware [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_1.decoDesc: This set of kitchen utensils is only related to Ankhors because they were made using raw materials derived from Ankhors. During the First Aggeloi War, people who lack metal would kill Aggeloi that spawned in metal-rich environments, then use their remains to make kitchenware. Ankhorilling pots and pans feature smooth, non-stick surfaces, zero pits, and great thermal conductance. These excellent properties ensure that Ankhor-based kitchenware crafting gets passed on till this very day.

item_iron_enr.name: Steel
item_iron_enr.decoDesc: Steel manufactured by Endfield Industries has been subject to multiple processing steps. It has been included in the list of Grade 2 Reference Materials in the Talos-II Blight Resistance Standards of Industrial Metals.

item_c16m2_newspaper.name: Soaked News Cutting
item_c16m2_newspaper.decoDesc: A news cutting that has been utterly soaked through. The water has made the words hardly legible.

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_01.name: Eternal Xiranite Power Core
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_01.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
...He once walked the streets with a large bowl of Tofu Stewed in Bamboo Drew, and claimed that he just concocted the next generation of Xiranite-based refrigeration technology.

item_fertilize_2.name: Fertilizer Test 2
item_fertilize_2.decoDesc: BY TALOS! LORD FERTILIZZA HAS ARRIVED!

item_gemcustomization_wuling_1.name: Wuling Basic Engraving Kit
item_gemcustomization_wuling_1.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
This kit, however, is very basic and only contains a simple essence. It is incapable of making an accurate engraving for any desired properties.

item_c16m2_notebook.name: Notes
item_c16m2_notebook.decoDesc: A page of notes that Laevatain left behind.

item_fbottle_glassenr_xiranite.name: Cryston Bottle
item_fbottle_glassenr_xiranite.decoDesc: Special chemical reagents can only be properly stored with Cryston Bottles. An example would be the notorious aqua mordax, otherwise known as the "corroding water" or localized ferric chloride solvent.

item_carbon_enr.name: Stabilized Carbon
item_carbon_enr.decoDesc: Multiple processing steps have achieved a delicate balance for this brick of elemental carbon.

item_iron_enr_cmpt.name: Steel Part
item_iron_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: A Steel Part with a wide range of uses.

item_plant_mushroom_2_1.name: Bloodcap
item_plant_mushroom_2_1.decoDesc: Bloodcap is likely to be a variant of a carnivorous fungus mutated by ambient Blight. Nutrients consumed by the fungus would course through its mycelia.

item_carbon_enr_powder.name: Dense Carbon Powder
item_carbon_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to create this uniquely fine powdered preparation of Carbon.

item_weekraid_collection_5_1.name: Classified: Security Bureau Staff
item_weekraid_collection_5_1.decoDesc: Classified records about someone working in the UWST Security Bureau. The attached photograph looks extremely discomforting, as though someone took the features of different people and pieced them together to create a new face.

item_carbon_mtl.name: Carbon
item_carbon_mtl.decoDesc: During the war, Endfield Industries managed to optimize their waste emission carbon capture technology.

item_drop_agfly_1.name: Hollow Aggagrit
item_drop_agfly_1.decoDesc: Aggagrit that can be occasionally harvested from Aggeloid "elytrons". Its flavor differs from other types of Aggagrit and many find it incredibly difficult to describe. Most would eventually arrive at this conclusion: "Maybe this is the taste of the sky."

item_weekraid_tech_6_2.name: Tactical Tempo Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_2.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Tactical Tempo" technology. "Use their energy against themselves to avoid exhausting yourself!" Lil' Dodge certainly knows how to translate Mr. Krad's lessons into short, simple phrases.

item_carbon_powder.name: Carbon Powder
item_carbon_powder.decoDesc: Carbon can be shredded to yield a powdered product.

item_case_bp_random_1.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [S]
item_case_bp_random_1.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. Since the crates are manually packed at the end of a shift, their contents are less than uniform.

item_pic_5_chr_0024_deepfin.name: Rod Casting Day
item_pic_5_chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc: "What is the best moment when angling?" "When casting the rod." "Why?" "Because therein lies your hopes. Uncertainty makes the heart race."

item_puzzle_m1l2.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L2
item_puzzle_m1l2.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_case_bp_random_2.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [M]
item_case_bp_random_2.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. This crate-o-surprise seems to have way too much leftovers.

item_case_bp_random_3.name: Exchange Crate-o-Surprise [L]
item_case_bp_random_3.decoDesc: A supply crate filled with leftovers from a weapon production line. "Whose Crate-o-Surprise is Truly Loaded" used to be quite an official game event in the Dijiang canteen.

item_levelup_corp4_animal_1.name: Wuling Fried Rice Upgrade
item_levelup_corp4_animal_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_case_bp_selfselect_break.name: Multi-Purpose Breakthrough Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_break.decoDesc: A supply crate containing promotion or tuning materials. The first step of personal breakthrough is to hit one's true limit. This alone is a long and arduous process.

item_case_bp_selfselect_exp.name: Multi-Purpose EXP Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_exp.decoDesc: We learn combat techniques by using combat records and other forms of cognitive carriers. Learning must also be revolutionized to prepare us for battlefields of ever-increasing brutality.

item_weekraid_collection_2_4_d.name: Gold Statuette: Mark
item_weekraid_collection_2_4_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Mark holding a suppressant. The people's faith in the hero and his final will manifested the suppressant in this Protocol Space, time and time again.

item_case_bp_selfselect_skill.name: Skill Up Selection Crate
item_case_bp_selfselect_skill.decoDesc: Super recommended by Mr. Krad with Instructor Lil' Dodge as a satisfied user. This selection crate has every supporting kit and item for personal training.

item_iron_enr_powder.name: Dense Ferrium Powder
item_iron_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this preparation of dense Ferrium powder. It is extremely popular amongst traditional artists.

item_preset_gem_5_smash.name: Flawless Essence: Crusher
item_preset_gem_5_smash.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_1.name: Advanced Progression Selection Crate Ⅰ
item_case_bp_selfselect_skillsp_1.decoDesc: A crate that contains all sorts of quality general purpose materials. Operator combat performance is not limited by race nor combat experience. Sometimes, they just need a bit of inspiration.

item_port_shaper_1.name: Moulding Unit
item_port_shaper_1.decoDesc: After jointly organizing a product discussion conference with UWST, Endfield Industries finally overcame the challenges involved in the replacement of moulding dies.

item_case_gem_random_1.name: Essence Supply EX
item_case_gem_random_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of useful essences gathered from various regions. Your weapon can be the latest experimental prototype, but this crate will have a fitting essence for it.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.name: Targeted Weapon Supply
item_case_wpn_selfselect_1.decoDesc: An Endfield crate of weapons gathered from various regions. Certain prankers have a habit of placing excessively dangerous weapons in this crate to give their friends a "surprise".

item_port_travel_pole_1.name: Zipline Pylon
item_port_travel_pole_1.decoDesc: The earliest ziplines of Talos-II were constructed to help traverse the precipitous Blighted regions of the uninhabited snowy mountains in the Northern Barrens. Ziplines were the leading technology that helped humanity defeat the Aggeloid Blockade.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_bp_1.name: Weapon Supply: Awakening
item_case_wpn_selfselect_bp_1.decoDesc: A supply option with plenty of weapons. Most soldiers who fought in the Second Aggeloi War mastered so many weapons that they could take anything from this and put up quite an impressive fight.

item_formu_t1_suit_wisdwill01_hand_01.name: AIC Tactical Gloves
item_formu_t1_suit_wisdwill01_hand_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: AIC Tactical Gloves.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_common_advlevel.name: Curated Weapon Supply
item_case_wpn_selfselect_common_advlevel.decoDesc: Something that helps the user face any enemy — even if the final outcome is annihilation. The Arsenal Engineer has adopted such standards to place the best possible weapons in the supply crate.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gacha_beginner.name: New Horizons Weapon Supply
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gacha_beginner.decoDesc: Initiate the journey, for the sake of all the tears, wounds, steel, and fire that have been shed.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_1.name: Arms OC: Smelting Forge
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_1.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the smelting forge.

item_formu_t3_suit_str01_edc_01.name: Armored MSGR Gyro T1
item_formu_t3_suit_str01_edc_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Armored MSGR Gyro T1.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_3.name: Arms OC: Express Delivery
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_1_0_3.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected express delivery.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_body_01.name: MI Security Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_body_01.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
It first saw service with human armies fighting at the Aggeloid Front.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_1.name: Arms OC: Solid Ice
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_1.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the hard, solid ice.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_2.name: Arms OC: Cosmic Voice
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_2.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the cosmic voice.

item_pic_1_chr_0019_karin.name: Reporting In
item_pic_1_chr_0019_karin.decoDesc: Dreams, hopes, and roaring passion — Heralded by her smile. She's reporting in.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_3.name: Arms OC: Far Expedition
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_3.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the far expedition.

item_sp_2_moss_2_agrange_1_1.name: Superhot Fruit Preserves
item_sp_2_moss_2_agrange_1_1.decoDesc: Fruit preserves with a sour and spicy flavor. Unripened citromes can be extremely sour, but cut them to pieces (along with the rind) and marinate them in a blend of tartpeppers and aggagrit condiments. The result is a refreshing riot of sour and spicy.

wpn_lance_0011.name: JET
wpn_lance_0011.decoDesc: An experimental weapon manufactured to the highest standards of Northmarch Support Hub. The prototype was designed by the now-disbanded Aerospace Research Center. An array of Originium compression jet engines gives this lance its turbo performance.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_4.name: Arms OC: Rising Mount
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_4.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the great mountain peaks.

item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_hand_04.name: Miner Fists
item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_hand_04.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Miner Fists.

item_port_cmpt_mc_1.name: Fitting Unit
item_port_cmpt_mc_1.decoDesc: Comes with grinding wheels, planing wheels, polishing bits, and milling cutters.

item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_5.name: Arms OC: Thunderous Peal
item_case_wpn_selfselect_gahca_c_5.decoDesc: A heavy crate with incredibly tight seals. "Availability of weapon choices translates into safer battlefield operations," thought the Arsenal Engineers. And thus they filled up the crate with weaponry that reflected the loud, thunderous peal.

wpn_lance_0013.name: OBJ Razorhorn
wpn_lance_0013.decoDesc: A standard weapon produced by Endfield Industries. Design is provided by the Creative Prototyping Team founded by Senior Arsenal Engineer Opero. Wielders are free to make their own adjustments to the spearhead module.

item_cbp_exp.name: Pass Experience
item_cbp_exp.decoDesc: Every item on the Protocol Pass is gathered from official operator interviews conducted by the Arsenal Engineers. These items include support projects that everyone hopes to see.

item_quest_sid_e1m4_powerstation.name: Electrical Supply Part
item_quest_sid_e1m4_powerstation.decoDesc:
A special part for electrical supplies designed for convenience. 
Its easy-to-dismantle and miniaturized designs pose certain risks. People can just carry off the part without permission.

item_cbp_voucher_originium.name: Pass Application: Originium
item_cbp_voucher_originium.decoDesc: Some Endfield operators enjoy referring to the Protocol Pass as their "wishlist". According to rumors, those who make a wish and place some Origeometry by their pillows during the eve of their birthdays will receive a satisfying reward from the kind little robots of the Arsenal.

item_cbp_voucher_pay.name: Access Pass Application: Customized
item_cbp_voucher_pay.decoDesc: "Good. Just sign your name here and you'll get your very own customized Protocol Pass... Oh? Efficiency? Don't worry. We'll airdrop the supplies to your place if necessary."

item_collection_ether.name: Aurylene of Valley IV
item_collection_ether.decoDesc: An Aurylene that can be found in Valley IV. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.

item_weekraid_ore_1_1.name: Malformed Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_1_1.decoDesc: A small, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can give birth to realistic projections of the past.

item_char_ap_supply_aglina.name: Chestnut Honey
item_char_ap_supply_aglina.decoDesc: Sweet and refreshing. Gilberta thinks you might have a liking for honey of chestnut flowers, so she bought some from a chestnut orchard during her messenger work.

item_char_ap_supply_laevat.name: Seasalt Ice Cream
item_char_ap_supply_laevat.decoDesc: Ice cream with a dash of seasalt to bring out its sweetness. This is one of Laevatain's most preferred flavors, of which there are quite a few.

item_log_belt_01.name: Transport Belt
item_log_belt_01.decoDesc: A basic conveyor belt for transporting things. Belts are the blood vessels of the AIC Factory.

item_char_ap_supply_yvonne.name: Strawberry Crepe
item_char_ap_supply_yvonne.decoDesc: A crepe with a generous load of stuffing. Yvonne also gave it some fondant accessories in the likeness of Frost-e-Bytee and Tink-a-Bella.

item_weekraid_collection_2_5.name: Specimen: Originium Branch
item_weekraid_collection_2_5.decoDesc: A fresh branch of the Great Originium Oak sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, someone grafted a withered twig of Seš'qamam witchcraft to the Great Originium Oak. This act caused the once-dead tree to sprout again with life.

item_char_break_stage_1_2.name: Protodisk
item_char_break_stage_1_2.decoDesc: A special disk manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard data etching processes. Often used with other devices to effectively alleviate physical fatigue of operators during training.

item_weekraid_tech_1_4.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 4
item_weekraid_tech_1_4.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_char_skill_level_10_12.name: Proto-Extract
item_char_skill_level_10_12.decoDesc: A stable material extracted from Blighted environments using specialized Techno-Protocol. It can improve bodily tolerance for more powerful enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_level_1_6.name: Protoprism
item_char_skill_level_1_6.decoDesc: A special crystal prism manufactured using Techno-Protocol and standard crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_pic_3_chr_0026_lastrite.name: The Still Blossom
item_pic_3_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: The vast lands embraced her as she slumbered. An eon of winters await her beck and call. However, the girl only wishes to offer a bouquet at the place of its rest.

item_char_skill_level_7_12.name: Protohedron
item_char_skill_level_7_12.decoDesc: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

item_char_skill_specialize_1.name: Metadiastima Photoemission Tube
item_char_skill_specialize_1.decoDesc: A synthetic item for detecting and verifying various field forces and actions at a distance. The tube usually comprises a time crystal sealed in a static vessel, and uses observable regression properties of the photons to achieve its purpose. Though typically stable, users should avoid breaking the vessel and stay out of areas between a pair of linked tubes.

item_char_skill_specialize_2.name: D96 Steel Sample 4
item_char_skill_specialize_2.decoDesc: A novel and artificial alloy of D32 steel and D64 steel that cannot exist naturally. D96 steel has inherited the excellent strength and Arts conduction properties of its constituents. It also features better performance in areas with unstable Originium activities. The material is still being experimented upon, with Sample 4 offering the best cost performance index.

item_char_skill_specialize_3.name: Tachyon Screening Lattice
item_char_skill_specialize_3.decoDesc: An ion trap that might be leveraging its innate Æther properties. The lattice ignores temporal factors and is capable of detecting and screening naturally occurring tachyon beams. Since the people of Talos-II are still incapable of activating and firing tachyons, the lattice is thus essential for any experiments involving random outcome solidification.

item_char_skill_specialize_4.name: Quadrant Fitting Fluid
item_char_skill_specialize_4.decoDesc: A hypothetical condensed matter in fluid state. Though it could be synthesized and the optical properties of the resulting materials could be observed, the actual structure and state of the fluid have yet to be successfully measured. The fluid effectively suppresses Originium sublimation in all Depths that could be artificially created, making it an extraordinarily effective filler.

item_port_loader_1.name: Depot Loader
item_port_loader_1.decoDesc: An upgrade plan was stipulated after the AIC Factory was deployed for a second time in a high-threat area. Blight-resistant steel was used to construct Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders.

item_port_log_hongs_bus.name: Depot Bus Section
item_port_log_hongs_bus.decoDesc: For facilities that incorporate Xiranite with AIC technology, the Xiranite particles mainly provide "stabilizing" effects against rifting or the Blight. Xiranite particles flowing within these facilities can ensure that the movement of goods in/out of the depot via loaders/unloaders would not be affected by local environmental anomalies.

item_proc_battery_2.name: SC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_2.decoDesc: A skilled artisan can easily convert a standard capacity (SC) battery into an improvised explosive weapon.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_edc_01.name: Frontiers Comm
item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_edc_01.decoDesc: A heavy communication device. To ensure signal quality in complex subterranean excavation sites, the Frontiers Comm is designed with just the signal sending feature.

item_formu_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_02.name: Mordvolt Insulation Wrench T1
item_formu_t2_suit_wisd01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Mordvolt Insulation Wrench T1.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.name: Endministrator's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.

item_plant_moss_seed_2.name: Citrome Seed
item_plant_moss_seed_2.decoDesc: Hobby botanists and gardeners of the Civilization Band once voted for the Most Common Plants in the Wildlands. Buckflower and Citromes both made it to the top 10 of the list.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.name: Perlica's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: An Originium fragment secreted away. It once belonged to the one she most admires. The fragment bore the hopes of that special someone, and ignited her passion for Protocol-Originium Technology.

item_liquid_plant_grass_1.name: Jincao Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_1.decoDesc: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of jincao extract.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.name: Chen Qianyu's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: A branch carefully cleaned to remove barbs and bark. She once swung it as a sword when she was but a girl who dreamed of being a hero.

item_weekraid_ore_1_4.name: Rough Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_1_4.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation imbued with life, hope, and a sprinkle of love... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Wulfgard's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc: An old firearm with obvious signs of modification. He knows where every part is, the conditions in which they work, and how they could be removed so he could use them individually.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.name: Arclight's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: A fowlbeast woodcarving made by the children whom the Songseeker once helped. The Songseekers carry the "hanna" with them and always extend a helping hand towards those who wish to survive. They are like fowlbeasts. Since the winds never cease, the seekers will never quit.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.name: Ember's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: A standard Oathkeeper dagger bearing the marks of many battles. With ice, snow, and mighty peaks as witnesses, the crusade shall continue, and the embers shall be re-ignited.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.name: Xaihi's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: A prayer of a Cabal of Tranquility cleric that Xaihi uses as a bookmark. This bookmark accompanied her as she read through the seemingly endless collection of the Cabal.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_6.name: Tainted Crystal-Embedded Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_6.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism. In addition to bits of Originium crystal attachments, the sample is coated with a Blighted material that should not be there in the first place.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.name: Gilberta's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: An intricate scented sachet giving off the refreshing scents of sour citromes and the cloying sweetness of floral petals. Gilberta made this by mixing all sorts of ingredients together. A whiff of the sachet's fragrance reminds people of her smile.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowshine's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: An intricate talisman engraved with these words: "May you be forever one step ahead of the storm" — Her wish is to protect precious lives who found themselves hopelessly lost in the snow, help them survive the disaster, escape the dangers, and lead them onto the safe road to home and loved ones.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Lifeng's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: A very old and dog-eared Martial Codex. The book is filled with scribbles that convey a young man's feelings, his hard work and dedication, as well as his hopes and dreams.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.name: Laevatain's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: A piece of paper filled with notes about the places she visited, the people she met, and the things that mattered to her. Freshly made memories are gradually filling up the gaps in her past.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Yvonne's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: A ticket to La Fantoma. You've been invited to enjoy sandy beaches and ocean winds... But that can wait till she completes her research paper about the Ætherside.

item_formu_t4_suit_atb01_body_01.name: Frontiers Armor
item_formu_t4_suit_atb01_body_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Frontiers Armor.

item_sm2l1m5_grass.name: Fresh Jincao
item_sm2l1m5_grass.decoDesc: Very few actually know how this plant tastes like. In truth, special cooking methods will bring about magical tastes.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_9_d.name: Densolite Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_9_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though it appears dense and heavy, it is actually surprisingly light.

wpn_pistol_0008.name: Wedge
wpn_pistol_0008.decoDesc: A legendary work of Northmarch Support Hub that perfectly embodies the style and virtues of Northmarch weapons. Features devastating firepower, total reliability, and absolutely abysmal handling and recoil.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.name: Da Pan's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: A special menu with all sorts of fowls, fins, and everything in between. Da Pan always traveled the lands of Talos-II with his iron wok, and it has been used to prepare delicious food of every cuisine.

item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_edc_03.name: Eternal Xiranite Auxiliary Arm
item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_edc_03.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Eternal Xiranite Auxiliary Arm.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0019_karin.name: Akekuri's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0019_karin.decoDesc: A set of Higashinese snacks. Rather than enjoying private moments for nostalgia's sake, she prefers sharing the snacks in other occasions. Examples include visitors of her place, colleagues during work breaks, or teammates at operational deployment briefings.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0020_meurs.name: Catcher's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0020_meurs.decoDesc: A handwritten menu. It is extremely exhaustive, and includes every Z7 teammates' gastronomic preferences, the flavors they like, and things they would not touch with a ten-foot pole.

item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.name: Metal Component
item_mission_sm1l2m2_metal.decoDesc: Old metal components found in the mines.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0021_whiten.name: Estella's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc: A psychedelic vinyl that inflicts dizziness and nausea. Estella says the sounds help her sleep. Is that ... actually possible?

item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_01.name: Hot Work Power Bank
item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Hot Work Power Bank.

item_weekraid_tech_1_5.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 5
item_weekraid_tech_1_5.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0022_bounda.name: Fluorite's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc: A small gadget shaped like a bomb. Activate the mechanisms in the right sequence to open the casing and access the candies within. Very nice, if only she would hand out these pleasant "surprises" more often.

item_weekraid_tech_2_3.name: Container Expansion Chip 3
item_weekraid_tech_2_3.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_charpotentialup_chr_0023_antal.name: Antal's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0023_antal.decoDesc: A stash of meticulously kept letters, all written by Antal's grandmother who lives New Wrankwood far, far away. The letters contain the most mundane greetings, the simplest messages of care, and the warmest lines of longing between members of a loving family.

item_regionbuff_wuling_5_1.name: Medical Reserves
item_regionbuff_wuling_5_1.decoDesc: You are always medically prepared, thanks to your familiarity with local intel

item_charpotentialup_chr_0024_deepfin.name: Alesh's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc: A very life-like lure. This is Alesh's new trick, one that exudes a lethal-dose of attraction to vicious predatory fins. Nobody knows which of them would bite next.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Ardelia's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: A rock sample mined from the depths of Talos-II. It is a record of this land's geological evolution, a collection of scars from wounds suffered in eons past, and a silent testament of this planet's history.

item_weekraid_collection_1_11.name: Specimen: Blighted Armorscale
item_weekraid_collection_1_11.decoDesc: A severely Blighted suit of armor sealed in a special jar. In some twisted aberrant, Rhodagn finally received a promise and inner peace. He took off his armor and led the Bonekrushers to the other end of the light. There, they would await their Baws's return.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0026_lastrite.name: Last Rite's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: A little flower frozen by frigid air. This species is often seen in the town cemetery where Last Rite came from. But since she was the one who gifted this, there shouldn't be other hidden meanings to it.

item_charpotentialup_chr_0029_pograni.name: Pogranichnik's Token
item_charpotentialup_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: An extremely tattered war banner that once stood amidst the howling cold and fluttered above the fields of snow. In battlefields populated by the living and the dead, this banner had never fallen, no matter how strong the enemy may be.

item_collection_ether_wuling.name: Aurylene of Wuling
item_collection_ether_wuling.decoDesc: An Aurylene that can be found in Wuling. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.

item_corp1_animal_1.name: Valley Pie
item_corp1_animal_1.decoDesc: A meat pie. Everyone in Valley IV grew up eating the famous Valley pie. Steaming pies, the stove, and a loving family always bring people hope.

item_corp2_animal_1.name: Meat Stir-Fry
item_corp2_animal_1.decoDesc: Cubes of meat stir-fried over hot fire. A hungry diner can easily go through three bowls of rice with a serving of meat stir-fry. There's a good reason why this is the *most* popular dish in the frontier.

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_hand_02.name: Type 50 Yinglung Gloves T1
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_hand_02.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
"I don't envy the power bestowed as I'm far from deserving of it. In fact, I should be the bones that offer them support."

item_weekraid_collection_1_11_d.name: Specimen: Blighted Armorscale
item_weekraid_collection_1_11_d.decoDesc: A severely Blighted suit of armor sealed in a special jar. In some twisted aberrant, Rhodagn finally received a promise and inner peace. He took off his armor and led the Bonekrushers to the other end of the light. There, they would await their Baws's return.

item_corp3_animal_1.name: Ginseng Meat Stew
item_corp3_animal_1.decoDesc: A herbal meal prepared by stewing redjade ginseng roots, meat fillet, and other ingredients. A common winter dish of the Wuling region. When the snow starts falling, a bowl of this hearty stew would offer the warmth you need.

item_corp3_grass1_1.name: Fortifying Infusion
item_corp3_grass1_1.decoDesc: A herbal infusion prepared by decocting redjade ginseng and jincao herbs. Typically consumed to revitalize the body. Many grievously wounded warriors used this decoction to treat various chronic conditions.

item_corp4_animal_1.name: Wuling Fried Rice
item_corp4_animal_1.decoDesc: A mysterious Ursine chef came up with this recipe as he traveled across the lands. It became famous throughout the frontier for its delicious blend of sweetness and heat.

item_crystal_enr.name: Packed Origocrust
item_crystal_enr.decoDesc: The Packed Origocrust is a result of multiple processing steps and looks just like a piece of precious "gemstone".

item_crystal_enr_powder.name: Dense Origocrust Powder
item_crystal_enr_powder.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to prepare this dense powdered form of Origocrust with particles almost invisible to the unaided eye.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_2.name: Cosmagaric Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A Cosmagaric mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_crystal_shell.name: Origocrust
item_crystal_shell.decoDesc: The thickness of the crystalline crust encasing an Originium formation (referred to as Origocrust) is often used to determine the age of the Originium vein.

item_pic_3_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Seeking for the Path
item_pic_3_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: The path of training is long, yet his eyes burn bright as he takes you as his example.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_04.name: MI Security Push Knife
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_04.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
The hilt is filled with an Originium propellant. Push the tip against the target and squeeze the trigger to fire the blade. It will instantly tear through armor and flesh like sponge cake.

wpn_funnel_0012.name: Freedom to Proselytize
wpn_funnel_0012.decoDesc: An Arts Unit designed by Mieszko Industries for Cabal of Tranquility. Every step from product design, verification, manufacturing, to tuning has been carried out under the guidance of a Cabal cleric.

item_databasefor006_1.name: Researcher's Notes (1)
item_databasefor006_1.decoDesc:
Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density last year: 0.0321 
Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density this year: 0.0322 
Further testing shows that Originium formations near the gorge are still growing at an anomalous rate.

item_databasefor006_2.name: Researcher's Notes (2)
item_databasefor006_2.decoDesc:
This is really odd. Originium formations are usually stable and would neither metastasize nor grow. But the Originium near the Originium Gorge exhibited signs of slow and steady growth despite normal ambient conditions. 
I don't know what's affecting it. 
We've established a surveillance camp and triangulated the source via our nearby mining sites. All readings point to something within the Originium Gorge. But the Originium formations inside the place are just too thick. It was impossible for us to head in for detailed surveillance. 
Perhaps we can use our prospecting machines. Upgrading them might give us a solution.

item_weekraid_tech_1_7.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 7
item_weekraid_tech_1_7.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_databasefor006_3.name: Researcher's Notes (3)
item_databasefor006_3.decoDesc: The Blight just ruptured. I don't care about the machines, but I must get the research data out of this place.

item_formu_t2_suit_agi01_body_01.name: Roving MSGR Jacket
item_formu_t2_suit_agi01_body_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Roving MSGR Jacket.

item_diamond.name: Oroberyl
item_diamond.decoDesc: A special product of cut Origeometry. These stones are extremely popular due to their beauty and wide range of uses.

item_domain_jinlong_exp.name: Wuling Regional Development Metric
item_domain_jinlong_exp.decoDesc: The mark of regional development in Wuling. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.

item_domain_tundra_exp.name: Valley Regional Development Metric
item_domain_tundra_exp.decoDesc: The mark of regional development in Valley IV. The proof of the hard work and sacrifices made by every contributor.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_1.name: Wuling Frozen Pears Bundle
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_1.decoDesc:
Rumors say that Wuling City grade schoolers can tell actual frozen fruits from those processed and made with Originium Arts. 
Do not lie to the children.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_2.name: Eureka Anti-smog Tincture [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_2.decoDesc: This Eureka Teashop product has been hampered by poor sales. Most consumers criticized it for its strangely sour and bitter taste. But one day came when people started believing it has the abilities to alleviate the discomfort caused by being too close to the Blight.

item_port_power_sta_1.name: Thermal Bank
item_port_power_sta_1.decoDesc: The Thermal Bank received 3 revolutionary tech upgrades in the last decade.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_3.name: Nymphsprout [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_3.decoDesc: "A hibernating nymph in winter, a budding sprout by summer." — Sishi Zhulinchong Kaolue (literally translated as: A Study of Grovenymphs in Different Seasons)

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_4.name: Wuxia Movies [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_4.decoDesc: Video tapes of top rated movies in Wuling. This anthology of six Wuxia thrillers (with a narrative structure inspired by that used in the Six Criminal Heists) illustrates the founding and history of Wuling. In fact, this anthology is publicly acclaimed as the easiest way to learn about Wuling City. Though one can readily find this anthology in many households, recent sales have spiked for reasons unknown.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_5.name: Chubby Lung Tianshi [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_5.decoDesc: A cute and lovely keychain fob featuring Chubby Lung — Honorary Tianshi, mascot of Wuling City, and ultimate winner of the TGCC Mascot Championships. Altogether, 36 varieties have been officially released thus far. Completing the Chubby Lung collection is a quest undertaken by Wulingers of every age.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_6.name: Xiran-Hue Fireworks [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_6.decoDesc: These fireworks explode into blossoms of brilliant Xiranite jade. Unfortunately, the manufacturer has not added any actual Xiranite to cut costs.

item_weekraid_collection_6_4_d.name: Gold Statuette: Dijiang
item_weekraid_collection_6_4_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Dijiang. A small shard of Origocrust replaced the Protocol-Originium of the original. It is aligned vertically to point straight at the sky, and symbolizes the indomitable spirit of humanity.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_7.name: Xiranite Filter Cores [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_7.decoDesc: A classical example of successfully adapting Wuling Xiranite technology for civilian water purification. These water filter cores are one of the reasons why Wuling is a household name in Talos-II.

item_pic_3_chr_0024_deepfin.name: Flowing with the Go
item_pic_3_chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc: Life can really rough people up, but the missing eye is really good at seeing the secrets hidden beneath it.

item_port_filling_pd_mc_1.name: Filling Unit
item_port_filling_pd_mc_1.decoDesc: The patented sterile packaging technology has greatly reduced the probability of product contamination.

item_puzzle_m2l1.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map2L1
item_puzzle_m2l1.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_8.name: Qingbo Rafts [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_8.decoDesc: A family version of the Wuling Outskirts bamboo raft. Since this is an export version, it comes with a Xiranite hybrid drive technology. Many residents in coastal cities purchased the raft to take part in the Siesta Surfing Festival.

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_01.name: Bonekrusha Heavy Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_01.decoDesc:
Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. 
This heavy suit of armor not only provide decent protection, wildland roamers also regard it as a symbol for a brutal and merciless way of life.

item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_9.name: Aerial Receptionists [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_jinlong_9.decoDesc: A suite of advertising drones. A Wuling proprietor received customer complaints when he added the drones to the waiting staff and made them play ads non-stop.

item_drop_agshield_1.name: Natural Chrysopolis Ingot
item_drop_agshield_1.decoDesc: A unique alloy that can be acquired by cutting out Aggeloid "shield armor". The Tianshi have realized that the metal is extremely dense and has properties similar to Hetonite.

item_weekraid_collection_3_3.name: Gold Statuette: Wulfgard
item_weekraid_collection_3_3.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Wulfgard. One could feel scorching heat while holding it. A pack of wolves holding guns and ammo in their jaws circle around him.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_10.name: Originium Saplings [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_10.decoDesc: An Originium formation that looks like a young sapling. After the destruction of the Great Originium Oak, the UWST began farming these saplings on a large scale. Each of them has a chance of growing into a new Oak. Though hardly any saplings showed any sign of growth, they remain highly sought after by Originium scientists from across the world.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_11.name: Vigilant Pickaxes [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_11.decoDesc: Pickaxes commonly used by miners working in Valley IV. They are fitted with special alarms that give off sharp warning sounds if the pickaxe sustains damage due to undetectable Blight in rock formations.

item_erhound_1_agmelee_1_moss_1_1.name: Hazefyre Blossom
item_erhound_1_agmelee_1_moss_1_1.decoDesc: Despite looking edible, we do not recommend eating this. This is a smoked "plant" prepared by using hazefyre-tainted jerky in place of sawdust and special aggagrit to replace sugar. Only the "bravest of the brave" would dare try it.

item_levelup_sp_1_moss_1_agmelee_1_1.name: Hub Emergency Ration Upgrade
item_levelup_sp_1_moss_1_agmelee_1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_12.name: Hard Noggin Helmets [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_12.decoDesc: "Hard Noggin. Guaranteed to keep your head in one piece."

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_2.name: Musbeast Scrimshaw Dangles [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_2.decoDesc: An ornamental dangle made using musbeast bones carved into various shapes. During early development of Valley IV, Sarkaz workers were employed to support various projects. Before concluding their contracts, the Sarkaz would present fellow Valley IV crew mates with musbeast scrimshaw dangles carved into the shapes of various machines. Witchcraft within the dangles also lets them float temporarily above Originium batteries. The dangles gradually became a common piece of decor in major cities and frontier areas of the Civilization Band.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_3.name: Witchcraft Mining Drill [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_3.decoDesc: A rather primitive machine jointly developed by the UWST and Seš'qa. These drills are often made using Origocrust imbued with witchcraft and commonly installed on the transport belts of various Originium factories. They can penetrate Origocrusts effectively without damaging the mineral kernel.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_4.name: Aggeloi War Tins [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_4.decoDesc: These tinned provisions date all the way back to the end of the First Aggeloi War, which means they have been around for more than a century. Please do not open or consume its contents. They are meant to provide spiritual encouragement far more satisfying than a filled belly.

item_equip_t2_parts_tundra01_edc_01.name: Miner Turbine
item_equip_t2_parts_tundra01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Protective equipment for mining operations. 
Valley IV Safety and Protection Standards dictate that minimum requirements for work protection must comprise a 2-layered protection of (i) a soft, cushioning layer and (ii) hard, rigid protection.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_5.name: Valley Hydroculture Fillets [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_5.decoDesc:
Scientifically inspired by the myosin hydrocultures of Originium agricultural research. These fillets are grown in the meat-packing plants in the regions around Valley IV. 
Please overlook the fact that the flavor, texture, and gastronomic trauma of hydroculture fillets are akin to those inflicted by soggy bread. These fillets are at least capable of peristaltic locomotion that lets them slowly squirm across a table.

item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_02.name: Hot Work Pyrometer
item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Hot Work Pyrometer.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_6.name: Unity Syrup [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_6.decoDesc: A stash of orally administered syrups for Oripathy prophylaxis. In Talos-II, a daily regimen of the prophylactic syrup can effectively reduce the risks of contracting Oripathy.

item_weapon_expcard_high.name: Arms INSP Set
item_weapon_expcard_high.decoDesc: A single-use toolset with AIC technology. Provides automated in-depth inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and significantly enhances weapon performance.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_8.name: Astarron Crystals [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_8.decoDesc: Blocks of crystals found within the remains of the giant Aggelos that once attacked Valley IV. Most were moved to various institutions for research and testing. However, given the beauteous appearances and ample supply of the crystals, many were fashioned into brooches, necklaces, and other jewelry by the workers.

item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_9.name: Scrap Toy Blocks [pkg]
item_domainshop_cargo_tundra_9.decoDesc: A set of building blocks made using scrap stone, metal, and wood. Many workers spent their break time (when they're not dismantling the Aggeloi or recycling various resources) building various things with all sorts of easy-to-find scraps. Someone eventually took this concept and created a franchise of toys out of it.

item_drop_agdisk_1.name: Conductive Effigy Stone
item_drop_agdisk_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered around an Effigy's halo. The stones exhibit excellent thermal conductance. Heat sinks made out of them are quite popular on the market.

item_drop_agmelee_1.name: Hard Aggagrit
item_drop_agmelee_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's "ramming horns". They can be used as a food marinade to give it special flavors.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_01.name: Miner Armor
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_01.decoDesc:
Protective equipment for mining operations. 
Valley IV Safety and Protection Standards dictate that minimum requirements for work protection must comprise a 2-layered protection of (i) a soft, cushioning layer and (ii) hard, rigid protection.

item_drop_agrange_1.name: Energized Aggagrit
item_drop_agrange_1.decoDesc: Strange minerals can sometimes be gathered from the Aggeloi's "energy-focusing tail stingers". They can be used as a food marinate to give it special flavors.

item_drop_dog_1.name: Fillet
item_drop_dog_1.decoDesc: A piece of fillet. It seems pretty fresh.

item_drop_enemycommon_1.name: Decryption Crystal
item_drop_enemycommon_1.decoDesc: The HQ provides gear design drawings while decryption crystals offer the necessary environmental readings. Combine these 2 to properly assemble a proper piece of Endfield gear.

item_drop_hsmob_1.name: Young Bamboo Sprout
item_drop_hsmob_1.decoDesc: Freshly harvested young bamboo sprouts from Qingbo Stockade. Tender, refreshing, and delicious. This quality food ingredient is famed throughout Talos-II.

item_drop_erhound_1.name: Pungent Jerky
item_drop_erhound_1.decoDesc: Dried, marinated jerky that looks obviously abnormal due to prolonged exposure to hazefyre. Eating this is NOT advised. However, you may consider using it as backup firewood.

item_drop_firebat_1.name: Chromatic Lipids
item_drop_firebat_1.decoDesc: A special backup fuel usually equipped and used by Bonekrusher Arsonists. It seems to be beast fat mixed with a certain dye. During periods of slim production and/or raiding, Landbreakers would occasionally acquire lipids from "local sources".

item_drop_hscrane_1.name: Grovenymph Pupa
item_drop_hscrane_1.decoDesc: Grovenymph pupae are high in protein. Although this one has escaped the fate of becoming a nymphsprout, it is a quality food ingredient and might end up as something else.

item_drop_hsfly_1.name: Waterlamp Glowbulb
item_drop_hsfly_1.decoDesc: The glowing organ of the waterlamp. The fluids within it can be used as an edible dye. Essential for the final garnish for the famous Wuling dessert resembling the Tianshi Pillar.

item_drop_hsmino_1.name: Qingbo Bamboo Chimes
item_drop_hsmino_1.decoDesc: A set of chimes delicately crafted with bamboo. A number of stockade residents would handcraft these chimes and cast them into the water to pay respects to those who have passed away. Hence, these chimes serve as vessels bearing their wishes and dreams.

item_drop_hstiger_1.name: Rakerbeast Longfur
item_drop_hstiger_1.decoDesc: Fine, fluffy fur collected from near the frontal paws of the rakerbeast. A rakerbeast would spend a lot of time grooming the "iridescent" part of its fur. You can even see threads of residual blood of unfortunate prey within the gaps.

item_equip_t2_parts_tundra01_hand_01.name: Miner Gauntlets T1
item_equip_t2_parts_tundra01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Protective equipment for mining operations. 
Valley IV Safety and Protection Standards dictate that minimum requirements for work protection must comprise a 2-layered protection of (i) a soft, cushioning layer and (ii) hard, rigid protection.

item_drop_lbmob_1.name: Powdered Grass Seed
item_drop_lbmob_1.decoDesc: A can of dried powder with bits of seed chaffs and coats. The powder is slightly toxic and the Landbreakers seem to consume it like an "instant energy drink mix". However, there is no discounting the possibility that the powder might be used as seasoning.

item_drop_lbroshan_1.name: Siegebreaker Gauntlets
item_drop_lbroshan_1.decoDesc: A pair of experimental gauntlets equipped by Bonekrusher Siegebreakers, crafted from miniature siege weapons. The Landbreakers obviously care little about user experience. These gauntlets would dig deep into their wearers' flesh and give them an incredible amount of pain.

item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_02.name: Hot Work Pyrometer
item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Equipment that features excellent fire resistance rating. 
Extreme heat is not terrifying. However, be wary if a place suddenly experiences an inexplicable change in temperature.

item_drop_lbshamman_1.name: Cartilage Bit
item_drop_lbshamman_1.decoDesc: Crushed beast cartilage. Bonekrusher Pyromancers would usually use this as "fuel" for their denstacks. However, hazefyre is not produced by burning cartilage. Rather, the pyromancers burn the beasts' remains as a means of convincing themselves of their victory at hand.

item_quest_e1m8_fixbox.name: Emergency Repair Kit
item_quest_e1m8_fixbox.decoDesc: An emergency repair kit of the UWST. It contains a set of commonly used repair tools.

item_drop_lbshield_1.name: Bitter Flour
item_drop_lbshield_1.decoDesc: Extremely poor quality flour of unknown ingredients. Overall color is a strange, grayish hue. The Landbreakers seem to have added some dried fungal powder to this mix as the sack of flour exudes a moldy smell.

item_drop_lbtough_1.name: Shattered Axe Blade
item_drop_lbtough_1.decoDesc: The dried bloodstains serve as a proof of its past. The terror and zealotry it once personified are now yours.

item_drop_mimicw_1.name: Nidwyrm Whiskers
item_drop_mimicw_1.decoDesc: Nidwyrms have "whiskers" growing on their heads. These appendages appear like tree roots and serve as sensory organs. These whiskers are naturally shed when spring gives way to summer. Although they offer limited nutritional value, they have an incredible texture.

item_weekraid_key_3.name: Detonation Unit Fragment
item_weekraid_key_3.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This is a casing fragment of a lost detonation unit. A gentle tap allows one to feel the explosive energy contained within.

item_drop_sandb_1.name: Axehorn
item_drop_sandb_1.decoDesc: The massive horn of the Axe Armorbeast broken during intense battle. Warriors would only drop their weapons when slain. The same applies to Axe Armorbeasts.

item_drop_slimeml_1.name: Slug Meat
item_drop_slimeml_1.decoDesc: This meat is rich in protein but must be meticulously prepared to remove all active Originium dust and particles from the tissues.

item_drop_wgabyss_1.name: Instant Vintage
item_drop_wgabyss_1.decoDesc: A strange liquid capable of inducing temporary tipsiness to those who sniffed it more than once. The fluid won the accolade of "smelling like a fine, eighty-year-old vintage" when some busybody gifted it to a kohlic beverage specialist. However, everyone knows that Aggelos formation is a process far, far shorter than that.

item_preset_gem_test.name: Turbid Essence
item_preset_gem_test.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as turbid.

item_weekraid_collection_3_4.name: Gold Statuette: Drill Crawler
item_weekraid_collection_3_4.decoDesc: A scale model so intricate that people might think someone actually shrunk the actual machine to make this. "This old boy should've been the one to ram that blasted Ankhor open! This old boy is the REAL CHAMP!" ...And it also comes with a text-to-speech module.

item_wpngem_enhance_dust.name: Coolant Gel
item_wpngem_enhance_dust.decoDesc: A special coolant gel used in the essence etching process. Results of etching are extremely sensitive to temperature changes. This process thus requires the use of coolant gels, which can be extremely expensive to make.

item_drop_wgshoal_1.name: Black Treacle
item_drop_wgshoal_1.decoDesc: A black liquid with an incredibly sweet and cloying taste. The primary contents identified through analyses are currently referred to as "artificial sweeteners".

item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_edc_01.name: Emergency Comm
item_formu_t1_parts_tundra01_edc_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Emergency Comm.

item_drop_wgslime_1.name: Resilient Water
item_drop_wgslime_1.decoDesc: A strange form of water. Although wholly composed of dihydrogen monoxide, it felt strangely gel-like to the touch. Perhaps the process of Aggeloid formation has induced strange changes to the properties of this material.

item_drop_wgthorns_1.name: Natural Sparkling Water
item_drop_wgthorns_1.decoDesc: This natural sparkling water has a strange fizz. It is cool, refreshing, and reinvigorating when consumed.

item_port_liquid_storager_nop_1.name: Fluid Tank (Self-Powered)
item_port_liquid_storager_nop_1.decoDesc: It took the engineers nearly 5 years to come up with a tank that can store corrosive fluids while being resistant against the effects of ambient Blight.

item_e1m1_treasure.name: TEMP: Super Valuable Cargo
item_e1m1_treasure.decoDesc: TEMP: Super valuable cargo. Seems to contain some unknown medication emitting a green glow.

item_e3m3_Key.name: Authorization Keycard
item_e3m3_Key.decoDesc: An authorization keycard paired with the special signal emitter for the Utjug Order. It has been stained with someone's blood.

item_e3m3_LT.name: Utjug Signal Emitter
item_e3m3_LT.decoDesc: An ordinary looking signal emitter, but it sports a bright red button that hints at great danger.

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_05.name: Type 50 Yinglung Knife T1
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_05.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
"When I saw familiar faces whom I once trained with carrying out crucial roles and protecting key locations, I felt ... like a defeated loser fleeing a terrible battlefield. I felt like a deserter."

wpn_sword_0016.name: Never Rest
wpn_sword_0016.decoDesc: A weapon from the furnaces of Fort Forgefane. Though it has undergone multiple rounds of recasting, the subsumed edge is still imbued with an intimidating force of domination.

item_equip_script_1.name: Amethyst Component
item_equip_script_1.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. Amethyst is the main material used for producing this.

item_equip_t3_suit_will01_edc_02.name: Mordvolt Resistant Wrench T1
item_equip_t3_suit_will01_edc_02.decoDesc:
An elegantly designed wrench with smooth outlines. 
"Pretty handy for bonking heads!" — A worker who wished to remain anonymous

item_equip_script_2.name: Ferrium Component
item_equip_script_2.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with ferrium for better ejection than the common variant.

item_equip_script_3.name: Cryston Component
item_equip_script_3.decoDesc: The full name of this component is Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Protocol Mould. This mould is mainly made with cryston for easier use.

item_factech_jinlong_key.name: Wuling Expansion Core
item_factech_jinlong_key.decoDesc: A special device containing environmental data of the Wuling region. Connect this to the Automation-Core to expand its data processing capabilities.

item_equip_script_4.name: Xiranite Component
item_equip_script_4.decoDesc: The full name of this component is a Biocore-Adaptive Single-Use Highly Transparent Xiranite Mould. The main materials for constructing this are Packed Origocrust and Xiranite. This mould offers better data transduction when compared to the standard variant.

item_equip_t0_parts_tundra01_body_01.name: Basic Armor
item_equip_t0_parts_tundra01_body_01.decoDesc:
Basic armor with simple structures. 
Gives people a peace of mind that far exceeds its actual defensive capabilities.

item_equip_t0_parts_tundra01_body_02.name: Basic PPE
item_equip_t0_parts_tundra01_body_02.decoDesc:

item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_02.name: Roving MSGR Flashlight
item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_edc_02.decoDesc:
A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. 
The sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break open old boxes or containers.

item_weekraid_tech_1_8.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 8
item_weekraid_tech_1_8.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_equip_t0_parts_tundra01_hand_01.name: Basic Gauntlets

item_formu_t2_suit_agi01_edc_02.name: Roving MSGR Flashlight
item_formu_t2_suit_agi01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Roving MSGR Flashlight.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_03.name: Prototype Heavy Armor
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_03.decoDesc: Though heavy enough, this improvised equipment only offers limited protection.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_04.name: Prototype Heavy Armor T1
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_04.decoDesc: Furnished with minor adjustments compared to the standard model. Though heavy enough, this improvised equipment only offers limited protection.

item_regionbuff_wuling_6_3.name: Full Vigor
item_regionbuff_wuling_6_3.decoDesc: Scientific stamina management gives improved endurance recovery

item_weekraid_ore_4_3.name: Rare Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_4_3.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation. "When the first heartbeat was heard, the answer was well within reach." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.

item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_06.name: Miner Cleansuit
item_equip_t1_parts_tundra01_body_06.decoDesc:

item_pic_3_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Daydream Without End
item_pic_3_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: What does she fantasize about when lying on a soft, fluffy cloud of pink? Really weird stones? Places she never went? Or...

item_port_battle_frost_1.name: LN Tower
item_port_battle_frost_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon with ammo of special crystal rounds filled with liquid nitrogen (LN). The ammo would shatter upon impact, spilling its freezing contents onto the enemy to apply frostbite that impedes their movements.

item_ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_1.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

item_formu_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_hand_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Pulser Labs Gloves.

item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_body_01.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. 
After attaching thicker and heavier armor plates onto the suit, the armor would likely end up at places where it becomes the target of powerful guns.

item_formu_t4_suit_phy01_hand_01.name: Swordmancer TAC Gauntlets
item_formu_t4_suit_phy01_hand_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Swordmancer TAC Gauntlets.

item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_02.name: AIC Alloy Plate
item_equip_t1_suit_stragi01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers heavy protection. 
Though extremely cheap to manufacture, it offers an acceptable degree of protection thanks to the quality materials used.

item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_body_01.name: AIC Light Armor
item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_body_01.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. 
It was a byproduct created during a test run of several mixed production lines involving various AIC Factory facilities.

item_ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_3.name: Messenger Express 10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_3.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_01.name: AIC Light Plate
item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. 
The biggest feature of this AIC gear is that it allows armor plates to be flexibly attached to the suit.

item_equip_t4_parts_wuling01_edc_04.name: Redeemer Seal T1
item_equip_t4_parts_wuling01_edc_04.decoDesc: This piece of gear is the byword for the difficult road ahead. "The quest is not yet finished, and so the journey is not yet complete."

item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_02.name: AIC Ceramic Plate
item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. 
"I'd love to believe in our technology, but this feels a little too light..."

wpn_funnel_0008.name: Detonation Unit
wpn_funnel_0008.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by Northmarch Support Hub. It is, without question, the unit with the best Originium Arts conductance. Only the most capable casters could master this weapon.

item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_hand_01.name: AIC Tactical Gloves
item_equip_t1_suit_wisdwill01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Structurally simple and modular equipment that offers light protection. 
Although they do not offer the best defenses, at least they are easy to wear.

wpn_lance_0012.name: Mountain Bearer
wpn_lance_0012.decoDesc: An experimental lance developed by Hongshan Swordmancers. The shaft of the weapon was forged using a special alloy to achieve both strength and resilience.

item_equip_t4_parts_wuling01_edc_03.decoDesc: This piece of gear is the byword for the difficult road ahead. "The quest is not yet finished, and so the journey is not yet complete."

item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_body_01.name: Roving MSGR Jacket
item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_body_01.decoDesc:
A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. 
Messengers working in and near the Valley IV region will often give their vehicles paintjobs with tree-like patterns. They hope the sight of these majestic plants that once protected this land can bring people strength.

item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_hand_01.name: Roving MSGR Fists
item_equip_t2_suit_agi01_hand_01.decoDesc:
A pair of gloves that messengers love to use. 
Messengers would also pass their time by fighting in the arena.

item_equip_t2_suit_str01_body_01.name: Armored MSGR Jacket
item_equip_t2_suit_str01_body_01.decoDesc:
A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. 
Scramblers are cheap and effective modes of transport on Talos-II. Messengers would often outfit these bikes with different mods and modules.

item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_01.name: Armored MSGR Gyro
item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_01.decoDesc:
An intricate fidget toy. 
Results from a trustworthy poll revealed that about 80% of messengers would modify this toy into a miniature dart grenade.

item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_02.name: Armored MSGR Flashlight
item_equip_t2_suit_str01_edc_02.decoDesc:
A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. 
The sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break the bones of those who refuse to talk.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_7_d.name: Tubular Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_7_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. Analysis reveals that the fragment exhibits unusually high energy density.

item_equip_t2_suit_str01_hand_01.name: Armored MSGR Gloves
item_equip_t2_suit_str01_hand_01.decoDesc:
A pair of gloves that any messenger would love to wear. 
Most messengers would install easy-to-use lifesaving ejection systems on their vehicles to contend with unexpected Blight ruptures.

item_port_sp_sub_hub_1.name: Sub-PAC
item_port_sp_sub_hub_1.decoDesc: The AIC Factory shall connect one node to the next in order to expand into the uninhabited frontiers.

item_equip_t2_suit_will01_body_01.name: Mordvolt Resistant Vest
item_equip_t2_suit_will01_body_01.decoDesc:
A sturdy, protective vest. 
"PPE must be properly worn in emergency repair sites. Failure to do so might make you see damaged facilities and machinery calling out to you for help... Just stop giving our surgeons extra work, okay?"

item_formu_t4_suit_atk02_edc_05.name: Type 50 Yinglung Knife T1
item_formu_t4_suit_atk02_edc_05.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Type 50 Yinglung Knife T1.

item_ticketgacha_weaponbox_constant_2.name: Cosmic Voice Issue Cert
item_ticketgacha_weaponbox_constant_2.decoDesc: A weapon exchange certificate from Endfield. Anyone, even non-Endfielders, can use this certificate and apply for support from the Endfield Arsenal.

item_equip_t2_suit_will01_edc_01.name: Mordvolt Resistant Wrench
item_equip_t2_suit_will01_edc_01.decoDesc:
An elegantly designed wrench with smooth outlines.

item_equip_t3_suit_agi01_edc_03.decoDesc:

item_equip_t3_suit_agi01_hand_01.decoDesc:

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.name: Glowbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_1.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Glowbugs can still give off a gentle glow.

preset_cbp_voucher_pay_1.name: Access Pass Application: Customized
preset_cbp_voucher_pay_1.decoDesc: "Good. Just sign your name here and you'll get your very own customized Protocol Pass... Oh? Efficiency? Don't worry. We'll airdrop the supplies to your place if necessary."

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_01.name: Aburrey Heavy Armor
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_01.decoDesc:
A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
Excavation of Precursor relics can be a rather convoluted process filled with unexpected changes. Equipment used during excavation must offer sufficient protection, dexterity, as well as offensive capabilities.

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_02.name: Aburrey Heavy Armor T1
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_02.decoDesc:
A suit of novel protective armor modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
A combat model of the Aburrey Heavy Armor. When compared to the standard model, this suit features additional weapon connection ports highly compatible with flamethrowers, grenade launchers, and other ordnance.

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_03.name: Aburrey Light Armor
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_03.decoDesc:

"Stop! STOP! Someone! Call the Cabal of Tranquility!"

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_body_04.decoDesc:
