item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_02.name: Aburrey Auditory Chip
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_02.decoDesc:
A piece of novel protective equipment modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
When exploring the unknown, proper sound insulation and hearing protection are extremely important. This chip can effectively help the wearer determine if they are suffering from auditory hallucinations.

item_sm1l5m1_reporter.name: Broken Handyterm
item_sm1l5m1_reporter.decoDesc: The latest handyterm but its screen is broken. Raquel the missing journalist left it at the place where she disappeared.

"It was embedded in the rock, and I thought I just dug out some rebars in the concrete. But ... but I think I heard it talking to me..."

monthlycard_lt_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert
monthlycard_lt_1.decoDesc: Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_05.name: Aburrey Sensor Chip
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_edc_05.decoDesc:
Novel protective equipment modified to suit the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
According to the engineers, future iterations of this armor will focus on full automation. The aim is to evacuate the wearer to safety, even if the wearer has been incapacitated.

item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_hand_01.name: Aburrey Gauntlets
item_equip_t3_suit_atk01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Novel protective equipment modified for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry. 
Hand protection linked to the protective armor suit. The fingertips have been furnished with nearly 100 micro-sensors of 6 different types to help wearers accurately determine what they actually touched — even after losing their sight.

item_hsfly_1_slimeml_1_hsmob_1_1.name: Simmered Xiranite Ball
item_hsfly_1_slimeml_1_hsmob_1_1.decoDesc: Meatballs dyed in a way to make them resemble Xiranite. Although the resemblance is close enough to make diners hesitate, the tenderness, fragrance, and flavors are guaranteed to conquer every foodie.

item_puzzle_m2l2.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map2L2
item_puzzle_m2l2.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_equip_t3_suit_str01_edc_02.name: Armored MSGR Flashlight T1
item_equip_t3_suit_str01_edc_02.decoDesc:
A sturdy hand-held electric lamp. 
The sharp spike on the other end can also be used to break the bones of those who refuse to talk.

item_equip_t3_suit_str01_hand_01.name: Armored MSGR Gloves T1
item_equip_t3_suit_str01_hand_01.decoDesc:

item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_edc_03.decoDesc:

item_muck_xiranite_1.name: Bumper-Rich
item_muck_xiranite_1.decoDesc:
Processed burdo-muck fertilizer. Can be used to fertilize planting plots. 
"Plop a bar of Bumper-Rich to your beautiful fields! Who'd say no to 88 tons per acre yield?"

item_port_planter_1.name: Planting Unit
item_port_planter_1.decoDesc: This facility is designed entirely by Endfield Industries. Its cutting edge technologies include real-time monitoring and modulation of silo lighting, temperature, and plant hormone levels.

item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_edc_02.name: Frontiers Comm T1
item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_edc_02.decoDesc: A heavy communication device. To ensure signal quality in complex subterranean excavation sites, the Frontiers Comm is designed with just the signal sending feature.

item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_hand_01.name: Frontiers Blight RES Gloves
item_equip_t4_suit_atb01_hand_01.decoDesc: The goal of Frontiersmate equipment is to give a squad of 3 to 5 combatants the ability to directly engage and terminate smaller Aggeloid hosts.

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_body_01.name: Type 50 Yinglung Heavy Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_body_01.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
Very few people know that the armor designer is actually a reservist who almost passed the YSTF screening test. Almost.

item_port_sp_hub_1.name: Protocol Automation-Core (PAC)
item_port_sp_hub_1.decoDesc: The Protocol PAC (PAC) represents the core technology of Endfield Industries. The seed was planted when they stepped through the door, and it is slowly growing to become a massive technological oak.

wpn_funnel_0011.name: Delivery Guaranteed
wpn_funnel_0011.decoDesc: A classical top-tier product of RAYTHEAN. Its prototype was deployed in the First Aggeloi War. The weapon has received numerous upgrades and optimizations since then, with the modern version offering incredible firepower that translates into greater protection and safety of the delivery.

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_body_04.name: Type 50 Yinglung Light Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_body_04.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
Very few people know that the armor designer is actually a reservist who almost passed the YSTF screening test. Almost.

item_pic_1_chr_0013_aglina.name: Patiently Waiting
item_pic_1_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: She waited for a response as though she's waiting for a return letter.

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_01.name: Type 50 Yinglung Radar
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_01.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
When the optimizations were finally complete, he added a few words next to the blueprints: "Heavens and earth may break asunder, but I shall prevail and emerge the victor."

item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_04.name: Type 50 Yinglung Knife
item_equip_t4_suit_atk02_edc_04.decoDesc:
A civilian version of Yinglung Special Task Force equipment. The lack of a crucial power component actually improved its compatibility with general users. 
"When I saw familiar faces whom I once trained with carrying out crucial roles and protecting key locations, I felt ... like a defeated loser fleeing a terrible battlefield. I felt like a deserter."

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_02.name: Bonekrusha Heavy Armor T1
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_02.decoDesc:
Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. 
This heavy suit of armor not only provide decent protection, wildland roamers also regard it as a symbol for a brutal and merciless way of life.

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_03.name: Bonekrusha Poncho
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_03.decoDesc:
Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. 
The poncho actually offers limited protection. It is often used as a symbol of rank and turns the wearer into a banner on legs.

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_04.name: Bonekrusha Poncho T1
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_body_04.decoDesc:

item_glass_bottle.name: Amethyst Bottle

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_04.name: Bonekrusha Mask
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_04.decoDesc: Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. The mask is a symbol of fanaticism. Yet faith alone will not keep anyone alive in a Blighted environment. It does not matter if it is dangling from a belt or being worn on the face. This mask is just a piece of flimsy wood.

item_spaceship_jinlong_gold.name: Wuling Convention Certificate
item_spaceship_jinlong_gold.decoDesc:
Endfield Industries and its partners have signed an agreement to trade supplies and commodities with this currency. 
This currency can only be used in the Wuling region.

item_weekraid_collection_1_5.name: Specimen: Bread
item_weekraid_collection_1_5.decoDesc: A small piece of bread sealed in a jar. This specimen weighs extremely heavy, as though some twisted aberrant forged the workers' steel-like will into a bread-like image.

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_05.name: Bonekrusha Mask T1
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_05.decoDesc: Equipment with designs inspired by the Bonekrusher Clan. The mask is a symbol of fanaticism. item_gachabyproducts_weaponticket.name: AIC Quota
item_gachabyproducts_weaponticket.decoDesc: A certificate recognized in the exchanges of supply quotas. People say the AIC Factory doesn't produce goods. It "prints" them. That's how fast and powerful it is.

item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_06.name: Bonekrusha Figurine T1
item_equip_t4_suit_attri01_edc_06.decoDesc: A trinket with hardly any practical purpose. The designer, however, claims that it can induce excitement and euphoria.

item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_hand_01.name: Tide Surge Gauntlets
item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Equipment designed by the Bureau of Swordmancers for those working near the Blight Tide. 
This is a question about the Blight Tide: Do the collapse of ancient dams start from within?

wpn_claym_0004.name: Exemplar
wpn_claym_0004.decoDesc: The latest standalone product from Mieszko Industries. Designs were based on a relic unearthed by the Cabal of Tranquility. The weapon itself was furnished with highly classified technologies, allowing it to cut through almost anything with ease.

item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_body_01.name: Tide Fall Light Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_body_01.decoDesc:
Equipment designed by the Bureau of Swordmancers for those working near the Blight Tide. 
This is a piece of memory about the Blight Tide: The unfeeling surges have always rejected the notion of life.

item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_edc_02.name: Turbid Cutting Torch
item_equip_t4_suit_burst01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Equipment designed by the Bureau of Swordmancers for those working near the Blight Tide. 
This is a touch of fear regarding the Blight Tide: When will the overhanging calamity make itself seen?

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_body_02.decoDesc:

item_pic_5_chr_0004_pelica.name: The Future
item_pic_5_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: She wove an infinity of possibilities that were then etched upon the blueprints. They are the future that she always carries with her.

item_port_miner_2.name: Electric Mining Rig
item_port_miner_2.decoDesc: Market performance for this facility was mediocre due to its equally mediocre stats.

item_ticketgacha_standard_single.name: Basic HH Permit

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_02.name: MI Security Scope
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
People often smuggle Mieszko Industries products to the wildlands. Some Landbreaker assassins treat the MI Security Scope as a top-tier accessory.

item_wgthorns_1_hshog_1_hsmob_1_1.name: Pan-Fried Double Crisp
item_wgthorns_1_hshog_1_hsmob_1_1.decoDesc: A dish that poses a serious challenge to the chef. Quillbeast livers can quickly overcook and assume a texture similar to rubbery leather. A skilled cook must first come up with a way to give it the same tender crisp of young bamboo sprouts.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_03.name: MI Security Toolkit
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_03.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
"Thanks, officer! I swear this'll be the last time I'm calling the police this month for forgetting my keys! PROMISE!"

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_05.name: MI Security Push Knife T1
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_edc_05.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
The hilt is filled with an Originium propellant. Push the tip against the target and squeeze the trigger to fire the blade. It will instantly tear through armor and flesh like sponge cake.

wpn_funnel_0013.name: Dreams of the Starry Beach
wpn_funnel_0013.decoDesc: A product from the elite series of Mieszko Industries. This weapon offers excellent Originium Arts conductance, making it more practical than other fashionable pieces that focused on style over substance.

item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_hand_02.name: MI Security Hands PPE
item_equip_t4_suit_criti01_hand_02.decoDesc:
Equipment from the MI Security series. 
Features miniaturized Arts Units for riot control and excellent energy conductance.

item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_body_01.name: Hot Work Exoskeleton
item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_body_01.decoDesc:
Equipment that features excellent fire resistance rating. 
"Humanity shall spread to every corner of Talos-II." Those who sacrificed their labors and lives believed in this. Thus they stood in the oceans to stop the rushing tide and fought upon the charred lands to subdue the flames.

item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_01.name: Hot Work Power Bank
item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Equipment that features excellent fire resistance rating. 
The Hot Work Power Bank can be treated as miniature generators. It effectively converts ambient heat of high temperature environments into usable power for the user.

item_levelup_anglem_corp1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_equip_t4_suit_fire_natr01_edc_03.name: Hot Work Power Cartridge

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_body_01.name: LYNX Heavy Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_body_01.decoDesc: A heavier version of the medics' preferred equipment. People usually refer to combatants wearing the LYNX Cuirass as "Walking Medkits". These lifesavers often stuff every pocket and holder of their armor with emergency medical supplies.

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_01.name: LYNX Connector
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_01.decoDesc:
The medics' preferred equipment. 
A connector component developed by Rhodes Island for data calibration. It can be connected to different health support systems to complete various forms of emergency medical care.

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_03.name: LYNX Slab
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_03.decoDesc:
The medics' preferred equipment. 
Some Blight injuries are not readily obvious. Hence, sensitive detectors became essential features on armor slabs.

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_04.name: LYNX Aegis Injector
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_04.decoDesc:
The medics' preferred equipment. 
The LYNX Aegis Injector delivers sealants into cracks to help repair broken shields. It can also be used during emergencies for sealing wounds.

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_05.name: LYNX Connector T1
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_edc_05.decoDesc:
The medics' preferred equipment. 
A connector component developed by Rhodes Island for data calibration. It can be connected to different health support systems to complete various forms of emergency medical care.

item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_hand_02.name: LYNX Gauntlets
item_equip_t4_suit_heal01_hand_02.decoDesc:
A heavier version of the medics' preferred equipment. 
Rhodes Island still has a tradition of furnishing their PPE with Oripathy monitoring modules.

item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_body_02.name: Swordmancer Heavy Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_body_02.decoDesc:
One of the products marketed by the Bureau of Swordmancers in its early days. 
The Tianshi took "gorge-sized capacity" as their design concept and literally achieved "absorption and neutralization" of energy-based attacks.

item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_hand_01.name: Swordmancer TAC Gauntlets
item_equip_t4_suit_phy01_hand_01.decoDesc:
One of the products marketed by the Bureau of Swordmancers in its early days. 
"Year's end. Brought my blade south. The mountain grew nine heads and roared incessantly. An auspicious day."

item_pic_5_chr_0003_endminf.name: Fully Grasped
item_pic_5_chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: Trust and faith congealed within your palm. The first fragment is named history. Its other name is Civilization and Life.

item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_body_01.name: Æthertech Plating
item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_body_01.decoDesc: Lightweight experimental protective equipment. "The people of Hongshan use feather as a simile for lightness in weight. The anti-gravity solutions provided by our Labs are just one tiny step away."

item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_edc_01.name: Æthertech Analysis Band
item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_edc_01.decoDesc:
Lightweight experimental protective equipment. 
"We're exploring the means of digitally analyzing signs of Blight growth. Everyone is welcome to sign-up for product trials."

item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_edc_02.name: Æthertech Stabilizer
item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Lightweight experimental protective equipment. 
"Keep the stabilizer on at all times, thank you. This will prevent you from soaring to the skies like an untethered balloon during parameter fluctuations."

item_quest_e1m3_fixtool.name: Prototype Parts
item_quest_e1m3_fixtool.decoDesc: Special parts found in the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. Give them to Andre to repair the prototype damaged during the Ankhorfall.

item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_hand_01.name: Æthertech Gloves
item_equip_t4_suit_poise01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Lightweight experimental protective equipment. 
"Always wear extra padding when using our products. If you experience any auditory or visual hallucinations, please TAKE OFF our products IMMEDIATELY and consume some food."

item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_body_01.name: Pulser Labs Disruptor Suit
item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_body_01.decoDesc:
Equipment with novel designs. 
Most could not understand why Endfield Industries developed a defensive suit for fighting digital warfare.

item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_edc_02.name: Pulser Labs Calibrator
item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_edc_02.decoDesc:
Equipment with novel designs. 
It searches the endless ocean of data for the well-hidden "golden outliers", and then erases them from existence.

item_weekraid_collection_1_6.name: Specimen: Toolkit
item_weekraid_collection_1_6.decoDesc: A set of tools sealed in a jar. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it: "...go bandit-smashing with my hammer..." or "...these pipefaced rascals..."

item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_hand_01.name: Pulser Labs Gloves
item_equip_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_hand_01.decoDesc:
Equipment with novel designs. 
Most could not understand why Endfield Industries added better thermal insulation for their Pulser Labs series PPE.

item_plant_grass_seed_1.name: Jincao Seed
item_plant_grass_seed_1.decoDesc: Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_body_01.name: Eternal Xiranite Armor
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_body_01.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
Most would struggle to establish a connection between kitchen work and Xiranite. However, a particular Wuling resident actually derives design inspirations when dining at at a restaurant.

item_pic_1_chr_0023_antal.name: True Calling
item_pic_1_chr_0023_antal.decoDesc: Out of everything in this world, he would gladly spend his entire life to pursue the highest secrets of the Originium Arts.

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_02.name: Eternal Xiranite Power Core T1
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_02.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
...He once walked the streets with a large bowl of Tofu Stewed in Bamboo Drew, and claimed that he just concocted the next generation of Xiranite-based refrigeration technology.

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_03.name: Eternal Xiranite Auxiliary Arm
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_edc_03.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
...It was said that the mad Tianshi saw a "self-feeding cycle" in a hotpot served by an Ursus chef. This inspiration allowed him to more than double the power duration of Eternal Xiranite protective equipment.

item_weekraid_tech_2_8.name: Container Expansion Chip 8
item_weekraid_tech_2_8.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_hand_01.name: Eternal Xiranite Gloves
item_equip_t4_suit_usp02_hand_01.decoDesc:
Legacy of a "mad" Tianshi. 
...Days passed and the mad Tianshi began to reject any food that "fail to deliver inspirations". After being reduced to skin and bones, he soon disappeared into the wildlands in pursuit of "palatable Xiranite".

item_expcard_stage1_high.name: Advanced Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_high.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge. This is also furnished with simulations of historical battles so that viewers can better appreciate the brutal nature of actual wars fought upon Talos-II.

item_expcard_stage1_low.name: Elementary Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_low.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge.

item_expcard_stage1_mid.name: Intermediate Combat Record
item_expcard_stage1_mid.decoDesc: A storage device with combat video recordings. New operators can use this to acquire combat knowledge. The end of each recording also features interviews conducted with operators who excelled in various training exercises.

item_expcard_stage2_high.name: Advanced Cognitive Carrier
item_expcard_stage2_high.decoDesc: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge. Thanks to support offered Cabal of Tranquility, this carrier features data compression technology and thus stores even more information.

Roarmaw, Old Witch, Hammersmith ... many tried to stop the rise of Nefarith. However, their weapons and even their bodies were cast into denstacks and have been burning ever since.

item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_hand_02.name: Hot Work Gauntlets
item_formu_t4_suit_fire_natr01_hand_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Hot Work Gauntlets.

item_pic_1_chr_0011_seraph.name: Desire for Knowledge
item_pic_1_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: She desires to investigate every facet of knowledge about everything in this world. Of course, that naturally includes you as well.

item_formu_t4_suit_heal01_body_02.name: LYNX Cuirass

item_weekraid_collection_4_4_d.decoDesc: Gold statuettes of the Collinses. Nobody knows why they showed up in the Protocol Space. The siblings have an entire arsenal of heavy weaponry behind them ... and give off a somber vibe representative of the UWST Security Bureau.

item_formu_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_edc_02.name: Pulser Labs Calibrator
item_formu_t4_suit_pulse_cryst01_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Pulser Labs Calibrator.

item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_body_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Eternal Xiranite Armor.

item_gemcustomization_wuling_4.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
Thanks to advancements in Techno-Protocol and its widespread use in precision machineries, multi-line engraving kits are now available.

item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_edc_01.name: Eternal Xiranite Power Core
item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_edc_01.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Eternal Xiranite Power Core.

item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_edc_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Eternal Xiranite Power Core T1.

item_formu_t4_suit_usp02_hand_02.decoDesc: A gear assembly document for: Eternal Xiranite Gloves T1.

item_gachabyproducts_charticket.name: Bond Quota
item_gachabyproducts_charticket.decoDesc: A certificate recognized in the exchanges of supply quotas. Endfield operators are guaranteed a wide range of amenities that cover daily expenses, traveling, and accommodations.

item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.name: Aketine Powder
item_plant_bbflower_powder_1.decoDesc: It is easier to extract target materials and substances from shredded Aketine.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_4.name: Bonsai of Life
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_4.decoDesc: A scale model of the Originium sapling. This is a gift, a blessing of growth, rebirth, and hope. It is usually placed at the side of a patient's bed.

item_quartz_enr.name: Cryston Fiber
item_quartz_enr.decoDesc: Cryston Fibers can undergo various processing steps to create a material for transmitting data and communication signals.

item_weekraid_collection_6_5_d.name: Specimen: Bonekrusher Dolls
item_weekraid_collection_6_5_d.decoDesc: A number of dolls sealed in a jar. They have been pierced through and bound together by a rusty wire. Vanguards, pyromancers, executioners ... bloodied, maimed, and screaming, all are tied together to create a tower of bodies.

item_liquid_plant_grass_2.name: Yazhen Solution
item_liquid_plant_grass_2.decoDesc: A solution prepared to maximize the effects of yazhen extract.

item_gacha_introletter_1_0_3.name: Headhunting Dossier
item_gacha_introletter_1_0_3.decoDesc: A notebook filled with all sorts of internal recommendations. New operators are often encouraged to make a list of reliable people they know. Of course, information acquired this way must undergo a lengthy process before the verified and validated names can be entered into the system.

item_spaceship_tundra_gold.name: Valley Convention Certificate
item_spaceship_tundra_gold.decoDesc:
Colloquially abbreviated as Vallico. Endfield Industries and all Convention signatories agree to use this fiat currency for trading supplies and commodities. 
This certificate is legal tender only in the Valley IV region.

item_plant_crylplant_2_2.name: False Aggela
item_plant_crylplant_2_2.decoDesc: An ancient plant that looks and feels like a rock. The False Aggela takes on the appearance of tiny Aggeloi when growing. Life on Talos-II never stopped evolving, even during humanity's silence.

wpn_lance_0003.name: Pathfinder's Beacon
wpn_lance_0003.decoDesc: One of the advanced weaponry manufactured by Endfield for their operators. This streamlined and lightweight weapon is well-balanced and would remind many people of the standard-issue lances once wielded by Vanguard class operators of Rhodes Island.

item_weekraid_ore_3_2.name: Fine Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_3_2.decoDesc: A sizable and dense crystal formation. "It ended when they touched their first tool and struck their first burst of sparks." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.

item_weekraid_tech_6_5.name: Energy Capture Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_5.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Energy Capture" technology. Enemies in the Aberrants are valuable resources as well.

item_rubbishKing_gift1.name: Norbert's Collection
item_rubbishKing_gift1.decoDesc:
Mr. Norbert gave you this souvenir as a token of his gratitude. 
This silvery material is either a rare metallic alloy or dangerously Blighted material... 
What exactly is it? Best not ask Mr. Norbert because the Junkyard Lord probably doesn't know either.

item_weekraid_ore_2_3.name: Common Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_2_3.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation. "Though they faced the daunting cliffs, humanity succeeded in chiseling out a stony alcove for the nurturing of life." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.

item_rubbishKing_tool1.name: Nitiloid Steel
item_rubbishKing_tool1.decoDesc: Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. It can be used to reinforce the facility.

wpn_lance_0006.name: Cohesive Traction
wpn_lance_0006.decoDesc: A classical product of RAYTHEAN's customizable manufacturing process. The weapon is based on a standard military lance, and features a diverse suite of special functions and customizable aesthetic components.

item_mission_c13_pack3.name: Medical Package
item_mission_c13_pack3.decoDesc: Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.

item_weekraid_key_4_d.name: Amberite Fragment
item_weekraid_key_4_d.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This sample resembles an amber-colored rock and was taken from the remains of an Effigy (Aggelos). Subjecting the sample to external impact causes the fragment to temporarily collapse into an amber-colored vortex before reverting to its original form.

item_weekraid_collection_3_5_d.name: Specimen: DELTA Aggelos
item_weekraid_collection_3_5_d.decoDesc: A small artificial Aggelos controlled by an Imitation Ankhor. This was Andre's new invention in some twisted aberrant. Since then, the Aggeloi became reliable assistants.

item_wgslime_1_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.name: Chubby Lung Jellied Greens
item_wgslime_1_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: These jellied greens are bouncy and jiggly to the touch. Special molds were used by the manufacturers to create jellied greens shaped like Chubby Lung. It is the only option since everyone likes Chubby Lungs so much. Kyaaa! Chubby Lung! They're so cute!

wpn_sword_0018.name: Twelve Questions
wpn_sword_0018.decoDesc: A razor sharp sword born of the wildlands. Different weaponsmiths would apply decorative wrappings on the weapon in very different ways.

wpn_pistol_0010.name: Artzy Tyrannical
wpn_pistol_0010.decoDesc: One of the most popular products from Mieszko Industries from their bold Fine Artists Collab series. These firearms feature great style to match its wildly violent performance. Its popularity is proven by the premium it commands in secondary markets.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.name: Kalkonyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkonyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_shot_filter_nm_5.name: Filter: Monochrome
item_shot_filter_nm_5.decoDesc: Endfield photography enthusiasts identified this as one of the most popular filters. Well ... let's use this one to make a documentary about Terran history.

item_gift_tundra_7.name: Frontiers Watch
item_gift_tundra_7.decoDesc: A popular science periodical in the Civilization Band. Recent issues of the magazine are focusing on the pioneering technologies of Endfield Industries.

item_pic_5_chr_0023_antal.name: A New Zenith
item_pic_5_chr_0023_antal.decoDesc: He learns. He gains enlightenment. He is on an endless path towards the only answer.

item_gacha_introletter_1_0_2.name: Headhunting Dossier
item_gacha_introletter_1_0_2.decoDesc: A notebook filled with all sorts of internal recommendations. New operators are often encouraged to make a list of reliable people they know. Of course, information acquired this way must undergo a lengthy process before the verified and validated names can be entered into the system.

item_port_dumper_1.name: Fluid Supply Unit
item_port_dumper_1.decoDesc: "Give me an alternative function. I need sales!"

item_gachabyproducts_weapongold.name: Arsenal Ticket
item_gachabyproducts_weapongold.decoDesc: "It doesn't hurt to be armed to the teeth." — Shayen Krad

wpn_claym_0007.name: Thunderberge
wpn_claym_0007.decoDesc: A specialized weapon manufactured by Endfield. The flamberge was furnished with interlaced Originium circuitry to enhance essence performance. This setup was inspired by various phenomenon observed on Talos.

item_gem_rarity_1.name: Turbid Essence
item_gem_rarity_1.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as turbid.

item_gem_rarity_2.name: Stable Essence
item_gem_rarity_2.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as stable.

item_plant_crylplant_1_2.name: Chrysodendra
item_plant_crylplant_1_2.decoDesc: Dendras are plants native to Talos-II. Farming dendras can be quite a challenge.

item_proc_battery_3.name: HC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_3.decoDesc: Many wildlands settlers make a living by stripping waste batteries of recyclable materials.

item_gem_rarity_3.name: Clean Essence
item_gem_rarity_3.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as clean.

item_gem_rarity_4.name: Pure Essence
item_gem_rarity_4.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as pure.

ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_1.name: Firewalker's Trail 10×Permit
ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_1.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

item_gem_stable_energy_point_tundra.name: Valley Engraving Permit
item_gem_stable_energy_point_tundra.decoDesc: A permit for expanded engraving produced in Valley IV. Engraving must be done in a strictly sealed environment to prevent uncontrollable corruption between different essences.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_1.name: Valley Single-Line Engraving Kit Ⅰ
item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_1.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The kit is provided with a guiding lens, allowing it to inscribe a desired engraving on the data module via optical interference.

item_weekraid_ore_2_1.name: Common Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_2_1.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation. "The first victors and survivors took the path, as well as the entire civilization, upon themselves." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_4.name: Valley Single-Line Engraving Kit Ⅳ
item_gemcustomization_tundra_2_4.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The kit is provided with a guiding lens, allowing it to inscribe a desired engraving on the data module via optical interference.

item_gemcustomization_tundra_4.name: Valley Multi-Line Engraving Kit
item_gemcustomization_tundra_4.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
Thanks to advancements in Techno-Protocol and its widespread use in precision machineries, multi-line engraving kits are now available.

item_gemcustomization_wuling_2_1.name: Wuling Single-Line Engraving Kit Ⅰ
item_gemcustomization_wuling_2_1.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The kit is provided with a guiding lens, allowing it to inscribe a desired engraving on the data module via optical interference.

item_pic_3_chr_0002_endminm.name: Quadrant
item_pic_3_chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: You stand right at the center of the crossroads.

wpn_funnel_0003.name: Fluorescent Roc
wpn_funnel_0003.decoDesc: One of the Arts units manufactured by Endfield Industries. It sports bold structural designs, superb Arts conductance, but is incredibly difficult to control. Mastering this weapon was considered a proof of competency amongst operators.

item_gemcustomization_wuling_2_2.name: Wuling Single-Line Engraving Kit Ⅱ
item_gemcustomization_wuling_2_2.decoDesc:
An engraving kit for customizing essence properties. 
The kit is provided with a guiding lens, allowing it to inscribe a desired engraving on the data module via optical interference.

item_gift_jinlong_1.name: Eureka Teabox
item_gift_jinlong_1.decoDesc: Special grade tea leaves offered by Eureka Teashop. The emerging brand is really proud of this product. Comes with a designer package that can be assembled into a mini-tea table.

item_weekraid_key_9.name: Aberrant Hazefyre Fragment
item_weekraid_key_9.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. A fragment that fell off an ever-rising orb of hazefyre. Those who approach it might hear the surging cries of a great crowd. Upon reaching the zenith, a warrior's path of carnage ceases abruptly.

item_gift_jinlong_2.name: Yinglung Dumbbells
item_gift_jinlong_2.decoDesc: Civilian variant of Yinglung training dumbbells. Furnished with an on-board weight manipulator. Automatically adjusts the weight to fine tune your resistance training.

item_gift_tundra_1.name: Aurylene Camera
item_gift_tundra_1.decoDesc: "The Blight may melt the world, but your individuality remains as keen as before. Choose Nikolas 006C. Connect our vision to the future."

item_gift_tundra_2.name: Cosmic Gate Puzzle
item_gift_tundra_2.decoDesc: A toy designed according to key components of the Cosmic Gate. These puzzles come in all sorts of assembling difficulties. Legends say those who complete the most challenging puzzles may have a chance of repairing the Cosmic Gate itself.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.name: Ground Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_1.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this buckflower preparation with "strangely" improved pharmaceutical activity.

item_gift_tundra_4.name: Breeze of Kjersch
item_gift_tundra_4.decoDesc: Intricately packaged perfume. The primary ingredients are extracts of plants growing on the snowcapped peaks of Kjersch. The fragrance is a reminder of refreshing mountain breeze.

item_glass_cmpt.name: Amethyst Part
item_glass_cmpt.decoDesc: An Amethyst part with a wide range of uses.

item_glass_enr_bottle.name: Cryston Bottle
item_glass_enr_bottle.decoDesc: Special chemical reagents can only be properly stored with Cryston Bottles. An example would be the notorious aqua mordax, otherwise known as the "corroding water" or localized ferric chloride solvent.

item_weekraid_collection_3_6_d.name: Specimen: Originium Formation
item_weekraid_collection_3_6_d.decoDesc: A dense Originium formation, the Endministrator's wrath left upon the land. In some twisted aberrant, the Endmin arrived a few days late and lost no memories.

item_glass_enr_cmpt.name: Cryston Part
item_glass_enr_cmpt.decoDesc: A Cryston Part with a wide range of uses.

wpn_sword_0021.name: Grand Vision
wpn_sword_0021.decoDesc: A quality weapon manufactured by Endfield Industries. Innovations include using an experimental Originium-based material as the blade body to give it excellent energy conductivity.

item_gm01m10_watch.name: Romano's Watch
item_gm01m10_watch.decoDesc: Rosa gave this watch to Romano. It keeps the time, but seems to have another feature.

item_port_soil_grass_fast_1.name: Jincao Plot (SIM)
item_port_soil_grass_fast_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing jincao. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_gm01m16_3.name: Linnaeus's Medicine
item_gm01m16_3.decoDesc: A half-empty vial of a mysterious medicine with a strange aroma. The bottle has a warning label that reads DO NOT OVERDOSE. The first two words were torn and barely legible.

item_weekraid_key_3_d.name: Detonation Unit Fragment
item_weekraid_key_3_d.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This is a casing fragment of a lost detonation unit. A gentle tap allows one to feel the explosive energy contained within.

item_gold.name: T-Creds
item_gold.decoDesc: A popular currency furnished with highly advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies. You know it's good money when you can purchase things with it.

item_weekraid_tech_1_6.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 6
item_weekraid_tech_1_6.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_hshog_1_hsmob_1_slimeml_1_1.name: Wuling Flame-Boyance
item_hshog_1_hsmob_1_slimeml_1_1.decoDesc: A generous and colorful dish. No one cares how the ingredient is cut or stir-fried, or how strong the fire is. Every Wuling household has their own Flame-Boyance approach.

item_iron_bottle.name: Ferrium Bottle
item_iron_bottle.decoDesc: A metallic bottle rarely seen in the market. Although ferrium metal offers better resistance against oxidation, people still prefer the steel variant.

item_log_pipe_converger.name: Pipe Converger
item_log_pipe_converger.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used in all sorts of production lines.

item_iron_cmpt.name: Ferrium Part
item_iron_cmpt.decoDesc: A Ferrium Part with a wide range of uses.

item_iron_enr_bottle.name: Steel Bottle
item_iron_enr_bottle.decoDesc: A bottle made of steel, the most common of its kind in the market.

item_weekraid_ore_3_1.name: Fine Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_3_1.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation. "The children left home but became lost in the night. Thus they never stopped crying." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.

item_iron_nugget.name: Ferrium
item_iron_nugget.decoDesc: A metal of Talos-II that is remarkably similar to Oriron. No one could explain the similarity.

item_iron_ore.name: Ferrium Ore
item_iron_ore.decoDesc: Many theories have been proposed about the origins of Ferrium. Before the age of industrial metallurgy, Ferrium was the most common metal that people used.

item_lbmob_1_dog_1_moss_1_1.name: Seš'qa Style Fillet
item_lbmob_1_dog_1_moss_1_1.decoDesc: A wholly black fillet with bits of bone inside it. Seš'qamam cuisine? Probably not. This feels more like a Landbreakers' fantasy about Seš'qamam food.

item_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.name: Cartilage Tack
item_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.decoDesc: Savory cookies with bits of cartilaginous material inside it. Look cute but have an extremely dry and gagging taste. This recipe was rumored to be a Landbreaker creation. It would seem that these raiders are actually capable of focusing on the details. A rare occasion indeed.

item_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.name: Instant Bone Soup
item_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.decoDesc: A soup mix of aggagrit seasoning and special bone meal. Just add hot water. Despite its savory and wholesome flavors, tasters can't help but weirdly fantasize if the soup mix is just as good "without the bone meal".

item_lbshield_1_slimeml_1_dog_1_1.name: Old Man John's Burger
item_lbshield_1_slimeml_1_dog_1_1.decoDesc: Getting an authentic Mama John's burger is not easy for explorations operating in the field. But if you try hard enough, you can make something that is at least eighty-percent similar to the Mama's famous sandwiches.

item_pic_1_chr_0009_azrila.name: An Oath Not Yet Fulfilled
item_pic_1_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Swallow the truth, break down the results, and regain power.

item_levelup_anglel_corp1_1.name: Savory Tangbao Upgrade
item_levelup_anglel_corp1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_plant_sp_seed_1.name: Reed Rye Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_levelup_anglel_flower2_1.name: Citrome Pudding Upgrade
item_levelup_anglel_flower2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_animal_angles_1.name: Savory Fillet Upgrade
item_levelup_animal_angles_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_bottled_insec2_1.name: Kunst Vial Upgrade
item_levelup_bottled_insec2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_bottled_insec2_2.name: Kunst Tube Upgrade
item_levelup_bottled_insec2_2.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

wpn_pistol_0006.name: Opus: The Living
wpn_pistol_0006.decoDesc: A contracted project developed by Portable Æthertech Labs. Cræft-adepts boldly furnished this weapon lined with relicolith, upon which special patterns have been engraved.

item_levelup_corp1_animal_1.name: Valley Pie Upgrade
item_levelup_corp1_animal_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_corp1_flower1_1.name: Coarse Flatbread Upgrade
item_levelup_corp1_flower1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_corp2_flower2_1.name: Tartpepper Salad Upgrade
item_levelup_corp2_flower2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.name: Scorchbug Powder
item_plant_tundra_insect_powder_2.decoDesc: The powdered exoskeleton of Scorchbugs can still give off a gentle glow. NOTE: Monitor facility temperature during processing.

item_levelup_corp3_animal_1.name: Ginseng Meat Stew Upgrade
item_levelup_corp3_animal_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_plant_spcstone_2_1.name: Igneosite
item_plant_spcstone_2_1.decoDesc: Scientists postulate that Igneosites are metamorphic forms of nyxite subject to volcanic eruptions followed by Blight exposure.

item_levelup_corp3_grass1_1.name: Fortifying Infusion Upgrade
item_levelup_corp3_grass1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_weekraid_collection_5_3.name: Gold Statuette: Old Bombtail
item_weekraid_collection_5_3.decoDesc: A gold statuette of a Tweety-Bomb. This one seems to have been in service for a while, since it is covered in rust and looks pretty exhausted. If it could talk, it would have plenty of stories to tell.

item_levelup_corp4_grass2_1.name: Garden Fried Rice Upgrade
item_levelup_corp4_grass2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.name: Steel Oath Medical Crate
item_mission_sm1l2m3_aedkit.decoDesc: A medical supplies crate with the designs and markings of the Order of Steel Oath. The Order uses this to store commonly used medical supplies.

item_levelup_ebl_flower1_1.name: Cartilage Tack Upgrade
item_levelup_ebl_flower1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_plant_moss_powder_1.name: Buckflower Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_1.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the pharmaceutical effectiveness of Buckflower.

item_levelup_ebm_flower1_1.name: Bugtack Upgrade
item_levelup_ebm_flower1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_ebs_flower1_1.name: Bizarrotack Upgrade
item_levelup_ebs_flower1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_erosionm_corp3_1.name: Corrective Remedy Upgrade
item_levelup_erosionm_corp3_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_erosionm_grass2_1.name: Blanched Remedy Upgrade
item_levelup_erosionm_grass2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_erosions_corp3_1.name: Sensory Remedy Upgrade
item_levelup_erosions_corp3_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_erosions_grass2_1.name: Ashpin Remedy Upgrade
item_levelup_erosions_grass2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.name: Garden Stir-Fry Upgrade
item_levelup_hsmob_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

wpn_claym_0013.name: Khravengger
wpn_claym_0013.decoDesc: A strange weapon released by Witching Hour. The blade body is chiseled out of an ordinary-looking block of ice, but its surface is infused with a special form of Originium Arts that made it literally indestructible.

item_levelup_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.name: Cartilage Tack Upgrade
item_levelup_lbmob_1_lbshamman_1_sp_1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_weekraid_collection_6_3.name: Gold Statuette: Perlica
item_weekraid_collection_6_3.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Perlica. It is exceptionally heavy for reasons unknown, though it might be an influence of the aberrant. The heavy responsibilities of the Supervisor are made manifest with this statuette.

item_levelup_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.name: Instant Bone Soup Upgrade
item_levelup_lbshamman_1_agmelee_1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.name: Sod-Turning Meat Soup Upgrade
item_levelup_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_.name: Mini Honey Slugpudding Upgrade
item_levelup_slimeml_1_agrange_1_moss_2_.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_levelup_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.name: Mystery Soda Upgrade
item_levelup_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.decoDesc: A processing method for increasing item usability.

item_port_thickener_1.name: Grinding Unit
item_port_thickener_1.decoDesc: This facility was based on a traditional crop processing machinery from Yan.

item_log_pipe_01.name: Pipe
item_log_pipe_01.decoDesc: A survey revealed that nearly 30% of residents in the Civilization Band believe that a dark and massive underground kingdom exists within the sprawling urban sewers.

item_log_pipe_splitter.name: Pipe Splitter
item_log_pipe_splitter.decoDesc: A pipeline adjustment unit with a smart sorting module. Can be used to reduce the complexity of various facility supply lines.

item_m1m8_grassSample_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_2.decoDesc: A thriving Thorny Yazhen plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_m1m8_grassSample_4.name: Umbraline Sample
item_m1m8_grassSample_4.decoDesc: A thriving Umbraline plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.

item_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.name: Sod-Turning Meat Soup
item_mimicw_1_moss_1_moss_2_1.decoDesc: A meat soup with a fruity flavor. What did people eat on the first day of constructing the Hub Base? There are plenty of stories around, but many veterans claimed they had a fruity meat stew when they turned the sod.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_2.name: Wulingstone Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A Wulingstone seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_mission_c13_pack1.name: Food Package
item_mission_c13_pack1.decoDesc: Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.

item_rubbishKing_tool2.name: Originium Integrated Circuit Board
item_rubbishKing_tool2.decoDesc: Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. It is an indispensable component of the facility.

item_port_battle_laser_1.name: Beam Tower
item_port_battle_laser_1.decoDesc: An experimental weapon armed with an energy converter. Treat this as a miniaturized version of a city-defense giga-cannon. The system is unpopular in the arms market due to its steep energy demands and the fact that it is an unstable and risky weapon platform.

item_pic_3_chr_0014_aurora.name: Snowy but Bright
item_pic_3_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: Like the brightest drop of sun atop the frozen peaks, the very sight of her brings instant warmth to those trapped in precipitous snow. She will brave the frigid cold and bring them to survival.

item_weekraid_tech_4_2.name: Portable Explosives Chip 2
item_weekraid_tech_4_2.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Portable Explosives" technology. It is personally designed by an Arsenal Engineer to guarantee your firepower.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.name: Pink Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Pink Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_port_soil_grass_1.name: Jincao Plot
item_port_soil_grass_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing jincao. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_mission_e1m4_fixtool.name: Bridge Elevator Control Panel Parts
item_mission_e1m4_fixtool.decoDesc: A component of the control panel for raising and lowering the bridge. The Bonekrushers ripped it out and hid it. It seems essential for getting the control panel to work.

item_mission_e2m3_key.name: Backup ID Pass
item_mission_e2m3_key.decoDesc: A backup ID pass. Use it to activate the control panel and open the gate of the Originium Science Park.

item_preset_gem_2.name: Stable Essence
item_preset_gem_2.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as stable.

item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.name: Tata's Log I
item_mission_e4m1_tatapica.decoDesc: An image record of the Blight Core taken by Tata at the entrance of the Research Center building.

item_port_marker_1.name: Memo Beacon
item_port_marker_1.decoDesc: Assist or deceive. Observe with your eyes. Validate with your actions... This is the proof of our "links" as we face the challenges of Talos-II together.

item_mission_gm02m10_key.name: Underground Key of Tianjing Courtyard
item_mission_gm02m10_key.decoDesc: An ancient artifact that Tianshi Bao described as a "key".

item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.name: Quarry Elevator Keycard
item_mission_sm1l3m3_elevatorcard.decoDesc: A keycard received from a UWST SAR Crew Mate. It is used to activate the elevators in certain areas.

item_rubbishKing_cd.name: Norbert's Collection
item_rubbishKing_cd.decoDesc: An object that feels pretty light. Lifting it gave off really loud noises. Best be very gentle with this thing.

item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.name: Worn Key Card
item_mission_sm1l3m4_keycard.decoDesc: A worn key card. It looks really old.

item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.name: Damaged Meds Box
item_mission_sm1l6m2_brokenmedicinebox.decoDesc: A box dented by heavy blows. There are some medicines left inside.

item_monthlycard_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert
item_monthlycard_1.decoDesc: Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.

item_pic_3_chr_0022_bounda.name: Action Oriented
item_pic_3_chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc: She hardly bears grudges. Her enemies usually don't last that long.

item_originium_ore.name: Originium Ore
item_originium_ore.decoDesc: A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.

item_originium_powder.name: Originium Powder
item_originium_powder.decoDesc: Endfield made use of Techno-Protocol to create a stable form of Originium Powder.

item_originium_recharge.name: Origeometry
item_originium_recharge.decoDesc: A derivative of Protocol Originium that can only be made with the most extreme processing environments. Some Endfielders call this the Tear of the Protocol. They believe that Dijiang felt sorrow and shed these Tears when she silently gazed upon the suffering of the Talosians.

item_preset_gem_5_force.name: Flawless Essence: Assault
item_preset_gem_5_force.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_paper_001_01.name: Torn Safety Warning
item_paper_001_01.decoDesc:
...Collapsing structure... Fall hazards. 
Off limits to non-professionals. 
If you need assistance, please contact... (the rest is torn and illegible) 
—Endfield Industries

wpn_funnel_0007.name: Monaihe
wpn_funnel_0007.decoDesc: An Arts unit developed by Hongshan Swordmancers and made using Xiranite. Given the fickle nature of this rare material, only wielders capable of the highest levels of focus and precision could wield this Arts unit effectively.

item_paper_001_02.name: Letter
item_paper_001_02.decoDesc:
Heard our Landbreaker brute say: "Punching is a skill. Tanking punches is also a skill." 
I think playing dead is a skill, too. 
Acting the fool and kneeling quickly enough should be skills as well. 
Brute is a true boss. His words, though simple, are filled with legit wisdom. 
Definitely gonna use these tricks in the next turf war.

wpn_funnel_0002.name: Jiminy 12
wpn_funnel_0002.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is designed by Endfield Arsenal Engineer Jiminy. The Arts Unit is extremely popular with newly minted Endfield operators.

item_paper_002_02.name: Bloodied Note II
item_paper_002_02.decoDesc:
Dammit. I got too greedy. It's a trap, and it broke my friggin' legs. I can't get out. 
If you read this, send my moolah to my mom. You can keep some for yourself. I hid them at...

item_paper_002_03.name: Wrinkled Note
item_paper_002_03.decoDesc:
(Handwritten scribbles) 
Don't trust that brat. I say we zero him once we make the creds. 
(Poorly written scribbles) 
Make it clean. Methinks the kid gots some bigshot backing him.

item_weekraid_tech_2_6.name: Container Expansion Chip 6
item_weekraid_tech_2_6.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_pic_1_chr_0002_endminm.name: Memory Mesh
item_pic_1_chr_0002_endminm.decoDesc: The last log is a small passage, or some form of a directive. The threads have been woven and the pieces are in place. You knew about all this.

item_pic_1_chr_0004_pelica.name: The Guide
item_pic_1_chr_0004_pelica.decoDesc: When debris of the stars blocks the light, she will calmly illuminate your path. Look how she shines.

item_pic_1_chr_0005_chen.name: Errant's Deed
item_pic_1_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: The Lung and her blade have embarked on a great adventure.

item_port_dumper_nop_1.name: Fluid Supply Unit (Self-Powered)
item_port_dumper_nop_1.decoDesc: "Give me an alternative function. I need sales!"

item_pic_1_chr_0007_ikut.name: Dipping Sun
item_pic_1_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: When the senses could no longer be relied upon, a Songseeker could always seek guidance from verses of the hanna.

item_quest_e1m6_needle.name: Emergency Invasive Medical Kit
item_quest_e1m6_needle.decoDesc: A medical kit for emergency treatment. Special contact point designs allow it to make germ-free incisions into human tissue.

item_pic_1_chr_0012_avywen.name: Found Ya
item_pic_1_chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: She had always traveled alone until she ran into you.

item_pic_5_chr_0029_pograni.name: Checkmate
item_pic_5_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: The smoke of ruin still lingered. Numerous pieces, living and dead, fell off the ponderous corpse. His blade served as the support of his body, his steel oath, and his vigil — And then he made his move. Checkmate.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_3.name: Messenger Express HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_3.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_weekraid_collection_2_2.name: Classified: Plan for Developing the Valleys
item_weekraid_collection_2_2.decoDesc: Classified records of plans for developing various valleys. The entire project starts with Valley I, Valley II, Valley III, Valley IV, Valley V, and more beyond. If things work according to plan, these production sites would be part of a network linked with Talos City, and become a powerful arm that stretches to the North.

item_weekraid_collection_2_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Chen Qianyu
item_weekraid_collection_2_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Chen Qianyu. One could feel light, piercing tingles while holding it. The power of her swordmancy courses across the statuette's surface, perhaps influenced by the aberrant itself.

item_pic_1_chr_0014_aurora.name: Moment for a Break
item_pic_1_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: A mug of hot cocoa of flavors from Kjersch is definitely a great choice before hiking the next mountain or receiving the next SOS distress call.

item_pic_1_chr_0016_laevat.name: Fire and Sword
item_pic_1_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: The flames swallowed her past. But a single promise steeled her resolve to swing her sword for the future.

item_pic_1_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Trendy-fique Discourse
item_pic_1_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: Got some time off the superbusy research project about the Ætherside. Now, why don't we talk about Monthly MARTHE and shimmer-glimmer meta-spectral nail varnish?

item_pic_1_chr_0018_dapan.name: The Journey Begins
item_pic_1_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: Lightly packed plus the trusty iron wok. The motor roars. Time to hit the road.

item_pic_1_chr_0020_meurs.name: Always on Duty
item_pic_1_chr_0020_meurs.decoDesc: The deep blue figure is always there with shield in hand. No matter the time.

item_pic_1_chr_0021_whiten.name: Intermittent Thinker
item_pic_1_chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc: She tried to free up some time to ponder when that drop of water will hit the ground.

item_pic_1_chr_0022_bounda.name: Got a Small Problem
item_pic_1_chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc: Don't let Fluorite know what you're thinking about... Oh. I think it's too late for that already.

item_pic_1_chr_0024_deepfin.name: Fellow Angler
item_pic_1_chr_0024_deepfin.decoDesc: The day's cloudy but not cold. Perfect for angling. Don't miss it.

item_pic_1_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Let's Start Playing
item_pic_1_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: "Mr. Dolly invited you too! Let's join its game!"

item_pic_1_chr_9000_endmin.name: Memory Mesh
item_pic_1_chr_9000_endmin.decoDesc: The last log is a small passage, or some form of a directive. The threads have been woven and the pieces are in place. You knew about all this.

item_preset_gem_5_magabn.name: Flawless Essence: Infliction
item_preset_gem_5_magabn.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_pic_3_chr_0003_endminf.name: Quadrant
item_pic_3_chr_0003_endminf.decoDesc: You stand right at the center of the crossroads.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.name: Chrysodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Chrysodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_pic_3_chr_0005_chen.name: Jianyu - The Language of Swords
item_pic_3_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: The sword is her longing for her mother, the path of her choice, and her will to keep you safe.

item_pic_3_chr_0007_ikut.name: Restless
item_pic_3_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: No storms could ever hope to stop her in her tracks.

item_port_power_pole_3.name: Xiranite Relay
item_port_power_pole_3.decoDesc: An electrical relay that combines Xiranite and Techno-Protocol electrical infrastructure technologies. The Xiranite components perform three major functions of identification, positioning, and stabilization. This avoids connection gridlocks between facilities and greatly minimizes the risk of accidental fires.

item_pic_3_chr_0012_avywen.name: Missing Me, Hmm?
item_pic_3_chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: She acquired plenty of memories and nostalgias from all sorts of people, but hardly ever mentioned her own.

item_plant_moss_spc_1.name: Firebuckle
item_plant_moss_spc_1.decoDesc: Buckflowers bloom in mid-April. Plants with the most fiery-red flowers would be called Firebuckles.

item_pic_3_chr_0013_aglina.name: A Pause Atop the Clouds
item_pic_3_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: She ceased her quick, dainty steps and was no longer in a rush. Someone familiar caught her eyes, and she paused for a bit.

item_weekraid_collection_6_6_d.name: Specimen: Blood Dust
item_weekraid_collection_6_6_d.decoDesc: The blood of the great nemesis sealed in a jar. The fluid has already seeped into the earth. This is but a warped and superficial fantasy. She walked into the light as humanity had long bled dry.

item_pic_3_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Selfie Invite
item_pic_3_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: No lighting is required when taking a selfie with Yvonne. After all, she is the brightest source of glow.

item_pic_3_chr_0018_dapan.name: Idling on the Peak
item_pic_3_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: So who has time aplenty, with a few fowlbeasts as company, for idling on the peak?

item_pic_3_chr_0020_meurs.name: Prepped for Battle
item_pic_3_chr_0020_meurs.decoDesc: Before the start of every mission, he would prep a dozen or so contingent plans for every subsequent situation.

item_pic_3_chr_0021_whiten.name: Urge to Share
item_pic_3_chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc: "How 'bout a sip? Oh... Well, it's a nutritious liquid blend of bugs and plant extracts. Yeah ... the taste is very interesting..."

item_pic_3_chr_0023_antal.name: Very Deep Focus
item_pic_3_chr_0023_antal.decoDesc: "Don't disturb him. He's carrying out his 115th test run of using Originium Arts to compress fire into ashes."

item_pic_3_chr_0029_pograni.name: The King and the Knight
item_pic_3_chr_0029_pograni.decoDesc: But he bore absolutely no hatred for the Empire. More than a century had passed since the "Emperor" died, yet a new formation of shieldguards rose behind him.

item_pic_5_chr_0005_chen.name: Soaring Lung
item_pic_5_chr_0005_chen.decoDesc: The blade is drawn. The lung has soared. The wind is blowing. The clouds are roiling.

item_pic_5_chr_0006_wolfgd.name: Predator's Glance
item_pic_5_chr_0006_wolfgd.decoDesc: The young predator stepped into his personal hunting ground as the Wolf Spirit howled. His eyes are on every single prey, and his guns will bring every single one of them down.

item_pic_5_chr_0007_ikut.name: Crescent Scimitar
item_pic_5_chr_0007_ikut.decoDesc: She always called herself an Echoling, but the many people she saved from breaker blades insisted on addressing her as an Aldertone.

item_pic_5_chr_0009_azrila.name: The Bastion Never Breached
item_pic_5_chr_0009_azrila.decoDesc: Red hot steel and solid blood were the brick and mortar of the northern bastions. The North is not her nightmare. It is merely her next destination.

item_pic_5_chr_0011_seraph.name: Gaze Long into Veritas
item_pic_5_chr_0011_seraph.decoDesc: Do not fear the unknown, and do not reject chaos. Such are the tenets that guide her search for truth.

item_quest_e1m6_drug.name: Injection Kit
item_quest_e1m6_drug.decoDesc: A medical kit capable of administering antibiotic solutions. Easy to use and effective.

item_pic_5_chr_0012_avywen.name: Mystery Invite
item_pic_5_chr_0012_avywen.decoDesc: The journey is uncertain, but the messenger never hesitated when toasting you this invite.

item_wuling_detector_coin_3.name: Keen Wuling Compass
item_wuling_detector_coin_3.decoDesc:
A positioning tool "handcrafted" by the residents of Qingbo Stockade. A few simple tweaks gave it the ability to detect Aurylene. 
Use with caution. The water within the device will start boiling violently as one approaches the item being detected.

item_pic_5_chr_0013_aglina.name: Let's Flip the World
item_pic_5_chr_0013_aglina.decoDesc: Turn your vision upside down and you'll see different views, experience different moods, and become a different you. Oh my, the world has become completely new.

item_pic_5_chr_0014_aurora.name: Carving Through the Snow
item_pic_5_chr_0014_aurora.decoDesc: The girl trudged through the peaks and carved a path down the snowy slopes. She is always straightlining her way to save lives in distress.

item_plant_sp_seed_3.name: Redjade Ginseng Seed
item_plant_sp_seed_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.

item_pic_5_chr_0015_lifeng.name: Heart of Youth
item_pic_5_chr_0015_lifeng.decoDesc: Like a block of natural jade, he will endure the chiseling and retain his purity of heart.

item_pic_5_chr_0016_laevat.name: An Invite to the Melting Fire
item_pic_5_chr_0016_laevat.decoDesc: Accompany her through long nights without memories. Fight with her and burn the dark, nightmarish enemies. Stand with her as she lights fires to illuminate future journeys.

item_pic_5_chr_0017_yvonne.name: Win-Win!
item_pic_5_chr_0017_yvonne.decoDesc: Bright-colored coatings, an upbeat soundtrack, and a satisfied smile of victory... She has recorded every joyous moment and now she's sharing them with you.

item_weekraid_tech_1_10.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 10
item_weekraid_tech_1_10.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_pic_5_chr_0018_dapan.name: All the Tastes of Life
item_pic_5_chr_0018_dapan.decoDesc: Life is nothing like cooking where you can prep everything before dunking them into the wok. However, the things we saw and experienced can be used as ingredients to offer all the tastes of life.

item_weekraid_ore_6_2.name: Sparkling Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_6_2.decoDesc: A sizable and dense crystal formation. "Within the aberrants, a future yet realized gives birth to an abominable gall." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.

item_pic_5_chr_0019_karin.name: Rising Star of Tomorrow
item_pic_5_chr_0019_karin.decoDesc: Like the breeze of daybreak, her smile conveyed hope not yet spoken and carried a courage that waited in silence.

item_plant_sp_1.name: Reed Rye
item_plant_sp_1.decoDesc: Reed Rye is a hardy cereal with an impressive yield. It is the staple food of most settlers in the frontier.

item_pic_5_chr_0021_whiten.name: Secret Hour
item_pic_5_chr_0021_whiten.decoDesc: Mind sharing your hard-earned free time with someone?

item_pic_5_chr_0022_bounda.name: Gray Fringes of the Rules
item_pic_5_chr_0022_bounda.decoDesc: Justice is always served. However, if justice decides to show up late, then we're in for quite a show.

item_pic_5_chr_0025_ardelia.name: Aspiration
item_pic_5_chr_0025_ardelia.decoDesc: Flowers blooming on cold, hard rocks ... barren lands teeming with life and warmth ... and idyllic songs humming by our ears... Professor, this isn't just a dream, right?

item_pic_5_chr_0026_lastrite.name: First Rime to Bloom
item_pic_5_chr_0026_lastrite.decoDesc: She has many unanswered questions, and many difficulties not yet overcome. Nevertheless, she will complete all of your assignments and bring back the smiles on everyone's faces.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_1_d.name: Mask Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_1_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. The scars of combat that cover the fragment seem to be moving.

item_pic_5_chr_9000_endmin.name: Fully Grasped
item_pic_5_chr_9000_endmin.decoDesc: Trust and faith congealed within your palm. The first fragment is named history. Its other name is Civilization and Life.

item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.name: Aketine Seed
item_plant_bbflower_seed_1.decoDesc: Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. Scientists believe this is caused by the absorption of rainwater with excessively high levels of Blighted materials.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_1.name: Mask Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_1.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. The scars of combat that cover the fragment seem to be moving.

item_plant_crylplant_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf
item_plant_crylplant_2_1.decoDesc: Some scientists believe that certain Blight conditions can transform any bush or shrubs into the Blighted Jadeleaves.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.name: Kalkodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_1.decoDesc: A Kalkodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.name: Vitrodendra Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Vitrodendra tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.name: Blighted Jadeleaf Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Blighted Jadeleaf tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_2.name: False Aggela Tuber
item_plant_crylplant_seed_2_2.decoDesc: A False Aggela tuber carefully selected for survivability.

item_shot_sticker_bp_1.name: Sticker: Memories
item_shot_sticker_bp_1.decoDesc: A sticker acquired from the "memories". Though light and tranquil, it carries quite a somber vibe.

item_weekraid_collection_4_4.name: Gold Statuettes: Collinses
item_weekraid_collection_4_4.decoDesc: Gold statuettes of the Collinses. Nobody knows why they showed up in the Protocol Space. The siblings have an entire arsenal of heavy weaponry behind them ... and give off a somber vibe representative of the UWST Security Bureau.

item_plant_grass_powder_1.name: Jincao Powder
item_plant_grass_powder_1.decoDesc: Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_plant_grass_spc_1.name: Fluffed Jincao
item_plant_grass_spc_1.decoDesc: Some people in Wuling believe that the jincao plant symbolizes hardiness. Many pieces of local literature use the plant as a metaphor for toughness and survival.

item_plant_grass_spc_2.name: Thorny Yazhen
item_plant_grass_spc_2.decoDesc: The thorny leaves of the yazhen plant can be used for angling. A few simple steps and bending would create a very effective angling hook.

item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.name: Thorny Yazhen Powder
item_plant_grass_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.

item_weekraid_collection_1_5_d.name: Specimen: Bread
item_weekraid_collection_1_5_d.decoDesc: A small piece of bread sealed in a jar. This specimen weighs extremely heavy, as though some twisted aberrant forged the workers' steel-like will into a bread-like image.

item_plant_moss_3.name: Sandleaf
item_plant_moss_3.decoDesc: The Hannabit Circuit proved themselves as the true masters of wilderness crafting and would use all sorts of natural materials to aid in their crafting.

item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.name: Ground Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_enr_powder_2.decoDesc: Techno-Protocol grinding is used to make this Citrome preparation with an extremely bitter taste.

item_plant_moss_powder_2.name: Citrome Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_2.decoDesc: Shredding would greatly improve the flavors of Citrome.

item_spaceship_cmpt_1.name: Aerospace Material I
item_spaceship_cmpt_1.decoDesc: Only use these materials within the effective range of Protocol facilities.

item_plant_moss_powder_3.name: Sandleaf Powder
item_plant_moss_powder_3.decoDesc: Shredding releases the abrasive grit from sandleaf tissues for industrial use.

item_plant_moss_spc_2.name: Umbraline
item_plant_moss_spc_2.decoDesc: Around 12 major Citrome cultivars are currently sold in the markets of the Civilization Band. They come in all sorts of names and offer different juiciness and sugar content. However, they are all Citromes.

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.name: Firebuckle Powder
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_1.decoDesc: A simple powdered preparation of Firebuckle. You can use it to treat wounds, but its pharmaceutical potential goes way beyond that.

wpn_pistol_0005.name: Navigator
wpn_pistol_0005.decoDesc: A novel concept of the year by Mieszko Industries. Let's use it to celebrate the memories of the great Navigator who led us in our unending journey across Talos-II.

item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.name: Citromix
item_plant_moss_spc_powder_2.decoDesc: A simple blended preparation that can be consumed by mixing with some water. If you're unlucky, you might get some bitter bits of rind in your pack.

item_weekraid_exp.name: Operation Metrics
item_weekraid_exp.decoDesc: Every number in this logbook represents our deeper understanding of this unknown realm.

item_plant_mushroom_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete
item_plant_mushroom_1_3.decoDesc: Every year, many frontier settlers would suffer multiple organ failure caused by ruby bolete poisoning. This often results from misjudging the edible stage of the fungus. Eating the fungus in ruby stage is extremely dangerous.

item_plant_mushroom_2_2.name: Cosmagaric
item_plant_mushroom_2_2.decoDesc: A common fungus that proliferated in various regions of Talos-II after the Cosmic Gate broke down. Terran fowlbeasts brought to the new world exhibit a special preference for these surprisingly hard "local mushrooms". Cosmagaric also disperse their spores by attaching them to the long feathers of the fowls.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.name: Red Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_2.decoDesc: A Red Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.name: Ruby Bolete Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_1_3.decoDesc: A Ruby Bolete mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.name: Bloodcap Mycelia
item_plant_mushroom_seed_2_1.decoDesc: A Bloodcap mycelial mass carefully selected for its activity.

item_shot_filter_nm_1.name: Filter: Bright
item_shot_filter_nm_1.decoDesc: Endfield photography enthusiasts identified this as one of the most popular filters. Brightness leads to a better mood.

item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.name: Rare Fungus
item_plant_mushroom_spc_2_1.decoDesc: A rare fungus that grows in Valley IV. It can be used as a catalyst when making medication. UWST scientist Linnaeus was the first to discover this property.

item_proc_battery_1.name: LC Valley Battery
item_proc_battery_1.decoDesc: Use and handle with care. Contents are hazardous to health. Compromising casing integrity may cause the said contents to leak.

item_plant_sp_2.name: Tartpepper
item_plant_sp_2.decoDesc: The leaves of this plant are considered the "most bitter herbs of the frontier".

item_plant_sp_3.name: Redjade Ginseng
item_plant_sp_3.decoDesc: Redjade Ginseng is a mild herb often consumed by people in Hongshan as a fortifying supplement.

item_plant_sp_4.name: Amber Rice
item_plant_sp_4.decoDesc: The rounded, jade-like endosperm of the Amber Rice is also regarded as "amber pearls".

item_plant_spcstone_1_2.name: Auronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_2.decoDesc: Humans have yet to figure out how nyxites form. This secret of Talos-II has yet to unveil itself.

item_plant_spcstone_1_3.name: Umbronyx
item_plant_spcstone_1_3.decoDesc: People usually name nyxite crystals based on their color (Kalkonyx, Auronyx, and Umbronyx) but these differences are just caused by the extent of oxidation.

item_plant_spcstone_2_2.name: Wulingstone
item_plant_spcstone_2_2.decoDesc: A mineral formation created by extremely complex hydrological changes. Wulingstone was first discovered by Hongshan Tianshi conducting hydrological surveys at the Wuling region. Under the influence of Æther, sediments carried by water would settle at certain depths and eventually form Wulingstone. These rocks are useful in fluviochronology and the study of local hydrological history.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.name: Auronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_2.decoDesc: An Auronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.name: Umbronyx Seed
item_plant_spcstone_seed_1_3.decoDesc: An Umbronyx seeding cluster selected for its usefulness in crystal nucleation.

item_plant_tundra_insect_1.name: Glowbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_1.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can give off a gentle glow.

item_plant_tundra_insect_2.name: Scorchbug
item_plant_tundra_insect_2.decoDesc: A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can glow and give off a bit of heat.

item_plant_tundra_wood.name: Wood
item_plant_tundra_wood.decoDesc: Let's chop down some trees first.

wpn_sword_0015.name: Aspirant
wpn_sword_0015.decoDesc: A first tier weapon released by Hongshan Swordmancers and also the only one that achieved decent popularity in the market. Many copies have been found in the wildlands, though.

item_port_battle_cannon_1.name: Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_1.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed Originium grenades. Designs are based on small field guns used during the Aggeloi War.

item_port_battle_cannon_2.name: HE Grenade Tower
item_port_battle_cannon_2.decoDesc: A launcher of compressed high explosive (HE) Originium grenades. This facility deals more devastating area damage compared to its standard counterpart.

item_port_winder_1.name: Gearing Unit
item_port_winder_1.decoDesc: A top-tier piece of equipment must undergo multiple processing steps that include textile weaving and compression lamination of various fabric and lining.

item_port_battle_lightning_1.name: Surge Tower
item_port_battle_lightning_1.decoDesc: Years of research on electricity-related Originium Arts gave rise to the Surge Tower. Power output has been greatly increased while minimizing the risk of friendly fire.

item_port_battle_shockwave_1.name: Omnidirectional Sonic Tower
item_port_battle_shockwave_1.decoDesc: A crowd control facility furnished with a specialized Arts unit. It can emit targeted sonic waves that overwhelm an entity's nervous systems to stun them. The overwhelming power of the sonic waves seem to allow them to disrupt Aggeloid movements.

item_port_battle_sniper_1.name: Sentry Tower
