item_port_battle_sniper_1.decoDesc: This weapon is inspired by the ranged weaponry of the Aggeloi. The designer has furnished it with high-precision optical recognition modules to accurately target high-threat targets and deal effective damage.

item_port_carrier_1.name: Easy Stash
item_port_carrier_1.decoDesc: "Are you sure the things inside belong to the Endmin?"

item_port_furnance_1.name: Refining Unit
item_port_furnance_1.decoDesc: Crystal delamination and thermal moulding... Heat changes, transforms, and even enables reactions in various materials to create something new.

item_port_furnance_nop_1.name: Refining Unit (Self-Powered)
item_port_furnance_nop_1.decoDesc: Crystal delamination and thermal moulding... Heat changes, transforms, and even enables reactions in various materials to create something new.

item_port_grinder_1.name: Shredding Unit
item_port_grinder_1.decoDesc: Can you hear the crunch of the heavy industrial shredders?

item_port_liquid_storager_1.name: Fluid Tank
item_port_liquid_storager_1.decoDesc: It took the engineers nearly 5 years to come up with a tank that can store corrosive fluids while being resistant against the effects of ambient Blight.

item_port_log_hongs_bus_source.name: Depot Bus Port
item_port_log_hongs_bus_source.decoDesc: For some engineers, Xiranite would often inspire crazy ideas that they themselves couldn't even explain. What is the endpoint of industry? Are there other possibilities for Xiranite, the material of unprecedented "freedom"? Will human industrial technology ever reach the "formless" state? The more the engineers think, the more they believe that every step they take is a revolutionary one.

item_port_miner_1.name: Portable Originium Rig
item_port_miner_1.decoDesc: The best selling product of Endfield Industries.

item_port_miner_3.name: Electric Mining Rig Mk II
item_port_miner_3.decoDesc: The Mk II upgrade of the electric mining rig features improved drill bit hardness, improved performance in rugged environment, and deeper mining capabilities.

item_port_power_diffuser_1.name: Electric Pylon
item_port_power_diffuser_1.decoDesc: Wireless electrical connection is one of the biggest technological breakthroughs achieved by Endfield Industries. This tech was further improved with Techno-Protocol to provide the very foundation of the AIC Factory.

item_sm2l1m1_bamboo.name: Bundle of Bamboo
item_sm2l1m1_bamboo.decoDesc: Bamboo for helping stockade residents repair their bamboo rafts. Someone has been kind enough to tie it up into a neat bundle.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_5_d.name: Crystal-Embedded Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_5_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism and has bits of Originium crystals, also shed by the said organism, attached to it. Unlike other plant matter, the sample seems hard enough to pierce armor.

item_port_power_diffuser_2.name: Xiranite Pylon
item_port_power_diffuser_2.decoDesc: A Techno-Protocol Electric Pylon furnished with a Xiranite receiving module. For electrical currents coursing between the relays, such modules serve as beacons in the darkness that accurately guide them towards their destination pylons with extremely low transmission loss.

item_port_power_pole_2.name: Relay Tower
item_port_power_pole_2.decoDesc: The Relay Tower is one of the most expensive AIC facilities to construct. Its overall design is based on the PAC.

item_preset_gem_3.name: Clean Essence
item_preset_gem_3.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as clean.

item_port_power_port_1.name: Electric Nexus
item_port_power_port_1.decoDesc: The very first Endfield Industries Electric Nexus was placed in the Northern Barrens. It had stood on that uninhabited permafrost for nearly a century.

item_port_pump_1.name: Fluid Pump
item_port_pump_1.decoDesc: The Endfield manufacturing center constructs this pressure engine by attaching a power module to a basic water pump purchased by the Procurement Division.

item_port_soil_1.name: TEST_Dry Plot
item_port_soil_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing TEST_CROP_1. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_2.name: TEST_Wet Plot
item_port_soil_2.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing TEST_CROP_2. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_grass_2.name: Yazhen Plot
item_port_soil_grass_2.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing jincao. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_grass_fast_2.name: Yazhen Plot (SIM)
item_port_soil_grass_fast_2.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing jincao. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

item_port_soil_moss_1.name: Buckflower Plot
item_port_soil_moss_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Buckflowers. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_sp_1.name: Reed Rye Plot
item_port_soil_sp_1.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Reed Rye. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_sp_2.name: Tartpepper Plot
item_port_soil_sp_2.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Tartpeppers. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.

item_port_soil_sp_fast_4.name: Amber Rice Plot (SIM)
item_port_soil_sp_fast_4.decoDesc: A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Amber Rice. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Wuling.

wpn_sword_0003.name: Tarr 11
wpn_sword_0003.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is designed by Endfield Arsenal Engineer Tarr. It is often the very first weapon of many field operators.

item_port_squirter_1.name: Sprinkler
item_port_squirter_1.decoDesc: Blight pollution of aquifers was a problem that plagued Talosians for years until Hongshan Academy of Sciences provided the definitive water treatment solution.

item_weekraid_collection_1_10.name: Gold Statuette: Qin Jiangchi
item_weekraid_collection_1_10.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Qin Jiangchi. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. Her dazed and blank expression is extremely well done. A single glance could remind people how she looked when gazing upon the Power Plateau in the great distance.

item_port_squirter_nop_1.name: Sprinkler (Self-Powered)
item_port_squirter_nop_1.decoDesc: Blight pollution of aquifers was a problem that plagued Talosians for years until Hongshan Academy of Sciences provided the definitive water treatment solution.

item_port_storager_nop_1.name: Protocol Stash (Self-Powered)
item_port_storager_nop_1.decoDesc: It took Endfield engineers nearly a decade to achieve tele-protocol of small items within limited range.

item_port_travel_pole_2.name: Zipline Tower
item_port_travel_pole_2.decoDesc: Recently, ziplines became a growing fad in the tourism sector as well as extreme sports athletes. The Endfield marketing team really demonstrated their skills in this case.

item_port_travel_pole_nop_1.name: Zipline Pylon
item_port_travel_pole_nop_1.decoDesc: The earliest ziplines of Talos-II were constructed to help traverse the precipitous Blighted regions of the uninhabited snowy mountains in the Northern Barrens. Ziplines were the leading technology that helped humanity defeat the Aggeloid Blockade.

item_port_unloader_1.name: Depot Unloader
item_port_unloader_1.decoDesc: In extreme environments, the Depot Loaders and Depot Unloaders can be directly connected to the facilities to ensure germ-free and low Blight transportation.

item_port_xiranite_oven_1.name: Forge of the Sky
item_port_xiranite_oven_1.decoDesc: The land is a cradle of wealth.

item_preset_gem_4.name: Pure Essence
item_preset_gem_4.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as pure.

item_preset_gem_5.name: Flawless Essence
item_preset_gem_5.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_break.name: Flawless Essence: Brutality
item_preset_gem_5_break.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_burst.name: Flawless Essence: Detonate
item_preset_gem_5_burst.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_combo.name: Flawless Essence: Pursuit
item_preset_gem_5_combo.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_heal.name: Flawless Essence: Medicant
item_preset_gem_5_heal.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_spirit.name: Flawless Essence: Inspiring
item_preset_gem_5_spirit.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_preset_gem_5_tacafter.name: Flawless Essence: Flow
item_preset_gem_5_tacafter.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

item_regionbuff_wuling_3_1.name: Productive Hunting
item_regionbuff_wuling_3_1.decoDesc: You have learned the local terrain, communities, traditions, and tactical intel. You now know the techniques to effectively acquire materials from local enemies.

item_preset_gem_5_tactic.name: Flawless Essence: Suppression
item_preset_gem_5_tactic.decoDesc: A reactive material dropped by dangerous enemies. Can be used for weapon activation and performance boosting. This sample is rated as flawless.

wpn_lance_0004.name: Chimeric Justice
wpn_lance_0004.decoDesc: An experimental lance designed by Endfield Industries with a very limited production run. This weapon features modular designs to support dismantling and reassembling in complex and hostile battlefield conditions.

item_proc_battery_4.name: LC Wuling Battery
item_proc_battery_4.decoDesc: Xiranite Power is a key project jointly pursued by Wuling and Endfield Industries.

item_puzzle_m1l3.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L3
item_puzzle_m1l3.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_puzzle_m1l6.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L6
item_puzzle_m1l6.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_puzzle_m1l6_mission.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L6 (Mission)
item_puzzle_m1l6_mission.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_puzzle_m1l7.name: Collectible Puzzle Piece Map1L7
item_puzzle_m1l7.decoDesc: PLACEHOLDER: This item is used to test if a map piece has been acquired. This item SHOULD NOT BE DISPLAYED.

item_quartz_glass.name: Amethyst Fiber
item_quartz_glass.decoDesc: Factory-drawn Amethyst fibers exhibit vastly increased strength.

item_quartz_sand.name: Amethyst Ore
item_quartz_sand.decoDesc: Amethyst has a wide range of uses in precision manufacturing. The crystal is one of the essential basic materials in the electronic industry of Talos-II.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.name: Spectral Splendor HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_weekraid_collection_2_3.name: Gold Statuette: Chen Qianyu
item_weekraid_collection_2_3.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Chen Qianyu. One could feel light, piercing tingles while holding it. The power of her swordmancy courses across the statuette's surface, perhaps influenced by the aberrant itself.

item_quest_e1m4_endfieldbox.name: Encrypted Endfield Crate
item_quest_e1m4_endfieldbox.decoDesc: A stolen Endfield supply crate. The container is encrypted. Even Perlica's authority level failed to open it.

item_quest_e1m4_ring.name: Suspicious Ring
item_quest_e1m4_ring.decoDesc: A suspicious ring acquired from a nomad. The Landbreakers seem to be wearing the same rings as well.

item_quest_e1m5_inhibit.name: Oripathy Suppressant
item_quest_e1m5_inhibit.decoDesc: A pharmaceutical agent capable of suppressing Oripathy symptoms for a short time.

item_weekraid_collection_4_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Yvonne
item_weekraid_collection_4_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Yvonne holding a vinyl between her fingers. The vinyl shares the same album cover that Yvonne showed you before, but the playlist sounds totally different. It felt as though the same musician has composed the music during a totally different time.

item_quest_e1m6_battery.name: Special Energy Battery
item_quest_e1m6_battery.decoDesc: An energy battery for special Endfield facilities.

item_quest_e1m6_tool.name: Small Auto-Tools
item_quest_e1m6_tool.decoDesc: An auto-tool capable of repairing lightly damaged facilities or machines. This technological product is only produced by Endfield Industries.

item_weekraid_tech_1_3.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 3
item_weekraid_tech_1_3.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_quest_e2m3_idcard.name: Research Center ID Card
item_quest_e2m3_idcard.decoDesc: Use this to open the tightly locked mechanical corridor at Research Center 1F.

item_quest_e2m6_battery.name: Square Battery
item_quest_e2m6_battery.decoDesc: An uncommon power unit with an older design. Only a few would use batteries of such specifications nowadays.

item_record_002_01.name: Radio
item_record_002_01.decoDesc:
"Madness! This is definitely madness! We can expect some Blight, but having a massive pit appearing at this place IS NOT NORMAL. All the figures are in the datasheet. Just one glance and you'll see! 
"My personal view is to EVAC NOW. ASAP! Then send in the professionals to handle the problem! 
"Of all the Blight phenomena out there, spatial anomalies are the most dangerous! I don't care about the results of whatever field of research you quote. Spatial blightery is the worst and most THREATENING! 
"Did none of you read about the worst Blight events we had in history? 
"I know our experimental data is stable and we shouldn't be getting Blight manifestations in this region, but if we don't take care of this Blight problem, our blighted names will be remembered in history as the blightbrained criminals who let it blight the hell of everything!"

item_regionbuff_wuling_1_1.name: Rested Offensive
item_regionbuff_wuling_1_1.decoDesc: Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to rest and preserve your strength for another push.

item_regionbuff_wuling_2_1.name: Rested Defensive
item_regionbuff_wuling_2_1.decoDesc: Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to consolidate your fortitude for holding these grounds.

item_regionbuff_wuling_2_3.name: Rested Defensive
item_regionbuff_wuling_2_3.decoDesc: Collecting Aurylenes gave you a good understanding of the local region. You have learned the best places to consolidate your fortitude for holding these grounds.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_10.name: Energized Densolite Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_10.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though exceptionally hard, it occasionally twists itself into spiral.

item_regionbuff_wuling_3_2.name: Productive Hunting
item_regionbuff_wuling_3_2.decoDesc: You have learned the local terrain, communities, traditions, and tactical intel. You now know the techniques to effectively acquire materials from local enemies.

item_regionbuff_wuling_3_3.name: Productive Hunting
item_regionbuff_wuling_3_3.decoDesc: You have learned the local terrain, communities, traditions, and tactical intel. You now know the techniques to effectively acquire materials from local enemies.

item_regionbuff_wuling_4_3.name: Outdoors Expert
item_regionbuff_wuling_4_3.decoDesc: Having searched high and low for Aurylenes, you now know every blade of grass and every lump of ore in this region. You have become an expert of the natural wilderness.

item_regionbuff_wuling_5_3.name: Medical Reserves
item_regionbuff_wuling_5_3.decoDesc: You are always medically prepared, thanks to your familiarity with local intel

item_regionbuff_wuling_6_2.name: Full Vigor
item_regionbuff_wuling_6_2.decoDesc: Scientific stamina management gives improved endurance recovery

item_rubbishKing_compressor.name: Norbert's Collection
item_rubbishKing_compressor.decoDesc: An object that feels quite heavy. Judging from the size, it probably contains extremely dense metals.

item_weekraid_collection_1_7_d.name: Classified: Meat-Packing Plant
item_weekraid_collection_1_7_d.decoDesc: Classified records about a meat-packing plant. In some twisted aberrant, the meat-packing plant became a terrible lair that mass produces Aggeloi.

item_rubbishKing_tool3.name: Prototype Superconductive Chip
item_rubbishKing_tool3.decoDesc: Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. This core component ensures the proper functioning of the facility.

item_shot_filter_nm_2.name: Filter: Cool
item_shot_filter_nm_2.decoDesc: Endfield photography enthusiasts identified this as one of the most popular filters. Depression is not the only mark of unperturbed emotions.

item_shot_filter_nm_3.name: Filter: Refreshing
item_shot_filter_nm_3.decoDesc: Endfield photography enthusiasts identified this as one of the most popular filters. Hope you still remember the fragrances of blooming flowers during that summer afternoon.

wpn_sword_0014.name: White Night Nova
wpn_sword_0014.decoDesc: One of the weapons from the furnaces of Fort Forgefane. The grip was constructed using a special rod drawing process to enhance force damping and grip. The blade itself was forged with a rare mineral quarried from the wildlands.

item_shot_filter_sp_1.name: Filter: Black and Gold
item_shot_filter_sp_1.decoDesc: Endfield photography enthusiasts identified this as one of the most popular filters. May it witness your magnificence and achievements.

item_sm1l1m5_Eriksson_workphone.name: Erikssohn Employee Roster HT
item_sm1l1m5_Eriksson_workphone.decoDesc: A handyterm with the Erikssohn Trading House employee roster. Just as Hartmann said, Aleksandr's name is missing from the roster.

item_shot_sticker_2.name: Sticker: HAS
item_shot_sticker_2.decoDesc: This sticker made it to the most recommended list amongst Endfield photography enthusiasts. Hongshan Academy of Sciences — A partner of excellence and quality.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_5.name: Crystal-Embedded Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_5.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism and has bits of Originium crystals, also shed by the said organism, attached to it. Unlike other plant matter, the sample seems hard enough to pierce armor.

item_shot_sticker_5.name: Sticker: UWST
item_shot_sticker_5.decoDesc: This sticker made it to the most recommended list amongst Endfield photography enthusiasts. United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II — A partner of excellence and quality.

item_slimeml_1_erhound_1_agfly_1_1.name: Pulled Slug Meat
item_slimeml_1_erhound_1_agfly_1_1.decoDesc: Slug meat that has been completely dehydrated. The pulled jerky is incredibly chewy. This is one of the best pet foods in Valley IV.

item_sm1l1m5_Alexander_docbag.name: Aleksandr's Document Holder
item_sm1l1m5_Alexander_docbag.decoDesc: A document holder furnished with the old logo of Clavis TGCC Trading.

item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_2.name: Tianshi Pillar Model
item_spaceship_exhibits_jinlong_2.decoDesc: A standard Tianshi Pillar model. Switch it on and adjust to maximum brightness to use it as a large table lamp.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_1.name: Mr. Rammu
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_1.decoDesc: A model of a cute critter. UWST crew mates treat long-ears as a bringer of courage as they are capable of surviving the dangerous environments of Talos-II.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_2.name: Arc 2000 Model
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_2.decoDesc: A scale model of a motorcycle. Arc 2000 is a classic and popular vehicle manufactured by Endfield Industries due to its light weight, reliability, and all-terrain performance. Even its scale models are widely sought after.

item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_3.name: Champion Drill Crawler
item_spaceship_exhibits_tundra_3.decoDesc: A scale model of the multi-purpose drill. During the sudden Aggeloid attack when construction work first began at the Valley, this drill crawler carried out the crucial task of smashing the Ankhor to bits.

item_ticketgacha_beginner_ten.name: New Horizons HH-10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_beginner_ten.decoDesc: To familiarize the freshly awakened Endministrator with the many ongoing projects of Endfield, the HR Division planned a special recruitment event.

item_weekraid_collection_1_9.name: Gold Statuette: Tata
item_weekraid_collection_1_9.decoDesc: A miniature model of Tata. Thanks to the influences of the Valley's Aberrants, it is fully clad in heavy armor plates and furnished with 6 auto-turrets and 4 jet propulsion nozzles.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_3.name: Rust Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_3.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It still gives off strange pulses of energy when held.

item_ticketgacha_special_single.name: Chartered HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single.decoDesc: Talos-II is home to plenty of talented individuals. To satisfy the ever-increasing demand for skilled operators of Endfield Industries, the HR Division has prepared a special and temporary contingent measure for headhunting.

item_weekraid_tech_5_1.name: Nodule Refining Chip 1
item_weekraid_tech_5_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Nodule Refining" technology. "These precipitation nodules are... well... kinda like fowlbeast eggs at different stages of development. Analyzing them is like opening a gacha egg."

item_ticketgacha_special_single_1_lt.name: Chartered HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_1_lt.decoDesc: Talos-II is home to plenty of talented individuals. To satisfy the ever-increasing demand for skilled operators of Endfield Industries, the HR Division has prepared a special and temporary contingent measure for headhunting.

item_weekraid_key_5.name: Axe Armor Fragment
item_weekraid_key_5.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This sharp and sturdy horn fragment was dropped off the back of an Axe Armorbeast. Any rock that comes into contact with the fragment would be pulverized to gravel.

item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.name: Firewalker's Trail HH Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_weekraid_collection_4_5_d.name: Specimen: Tube Professor
item_weekraid_collection_4_5_d.decoDesc: A miniature tube professor sealed in a jar. It seems to have some resemblance to Pocus... And strangely enough, it is shaking wildly in its jar.

item_ticketgacha_special_ten.name: Chartered HH-10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_ten.decoDesc: When tales of the Endministrator's heroic deeds spread to a place, Endfielders at the HR Division would be quickly overwhelmed with work. When the hectic OT blows over, new faces will show up in the roster of Endfield operators.

item_ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_2.name: Spectral Splendor 10×Permit
item_ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

item_tundra_detector_coin_3.name: Keen Valley Compass
item_tundra_detector_coin_3.decoDesc:
An Arts Unit for detecting Aurylene. This device looks like a compass, and contains a tiny Aurylene in its center to locate other Aurylene in the environment. 
This "compass" seems to be operating at an overclocked state. The needle would spin wildly upon simple activation.

item_tundra_detector_trchest_3.name: Keen Valley Detector
item_tundra_detector_trchest_3.decoDesc:
A special detector once created by prospectors looking for metal resources in Valley IV. It is made of the same metals used in storage crates. Using this points you to storage crates scattered throughout the area. 
Several words have been engraved along the edge of the device: "To those who persevere in hopelessness."

item_user_avatar_bp_1_0.name: New Horizons
item_user_avatar_bp_1_0.decoDesc: Go forth. A new, boundless world awaits.

item_weekraid_collection_5_4.name: Gold Statuette: Crowe
item_weekraid_collection_5_4.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Crowe shrouded in hazefyre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. The face of the statuette is a twisted grimace of sadness, denial, and rage.

item_weekraid_collection_5_2.name: Classified: Final Will
item_weekraid_collection_5_2.decoDesc: Classified records about several wills. The words on the letters kept changing: "I never regretted joining the Security Bureau, baby sis..." In some twisted aberrant, people failed to contain the disaster quickly enough. The words of the dead echo upon these pieces of paper.

wpn_funnel_0009.name: Oblivion
wpn_funnel_0009.decoDesc: One of the Arts units developed by Witching Hour. With the exception of its basic Originium circuitries, the rest of the unit was constructed using an unknown material. Can this really be built in Talos-II?

ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.name: Spectral Splendor HH Permit
ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

item_user_avatar_frame_activity_1.name: Carly's Fairytale
item_user_avatar_frame_activity_1.decoDesc: The completed storybook. A child's little wish was accomplished with a bit of adventure.

item_user_avatar_frame_bp_1_0.name: New Horizons
item_user_avatar_frame_bp_1_0.decoDesc: Go forth. A new, boundless world awaits.

item_weekraid_key_9_d.name: Aberrant Hazefyre Fragment
item_weekraid_key_9_d.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. A fragment that fell off an ever-rising orb of hazefyre. Those who approach it might hear the surging cries of a great crowd. Upon reaching the zenith, a warrior's path of carnage ceases abruptly.

item_weapon_break_high.name: Heavy Cast Die
item_weapon_break_high.decoDesc: A heavy casting die made using rare materials. Techno-Protocol activation lets this die enhance general material strengths in weapons.

item_weapon_break_low.name: Cast Die
item_weapon_break_low.decoDesc: A casting die made using rare materials. Techno-Protocol activation lets this die enhance general material strengths in weapons.

item_weapon_expcard_low.name: Arms Inspector
item_weapon_expcard_low.decoDesc: A single-use micro-device with AIC technology. Provides automated inspection of weapon parts. Also repairs internal material damage and slightly enhances weapon performance.

item_weapon_expcard_mid.name: Arms INSP Kit
item_weapon_expcard_mid.decoDesc: A single-use mini-kit with AIC technology. Provides automated inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and enhances weapon performance.

item_weekraid_collection_1_1.name: Classified: Aggelos Rotreed
item_weekraid_collection_1_1.decoDesc: Classified records about a particular plant. It is native to the Valley's Aberrants and common in areas with Aggelos remains in the Protocol Space. This seems to suggest that the plant grew on the remains themselves.

item_weekraid_collection_1_12.name: Specimen: Denstack Fragment
item_weekraid_collection_1_12.decoDesc: A special mini-denstack fragment created in some twisted aberrant and sealed away in a special jar. If the Bonekrushers were to forcibly replace Protocol-Originium with "blessings", they would be able to ride the flowing hazefyre itself.

item_weekraid_collection_1_12_d.name: Specimen: Denstack Fragment
item_weekraid_collection_1_12_d.decoDesc: A special mini-denstack fragment created in some twisted aberrant and sealed away in a special jar. If the Bonekrushers were to forcibly replace Protocol-Originium with "blessings", they would be able to ride the flowing hazefyre itself.

item_weekraid_collection_1_2.name: Classified: Underground Boxer
item_weekraid_collection_1_2.decoDesc: Classified records about an underground boxer. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it. "Fought worthier opponents in the underground arenas of the Asphalt Roundabout..." it boasted.

item_weekraid_collection_1_2_d.name: Classified: Underground Boxer
item_weekraid_collection_1_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records about an underground boxer. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it. "Fought worthier opponents in the underground arenas of the Asphalt Roundabout..." it boasted.

item_weekraid_collection_1_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Bigfowl
item_weekraid_collection_1_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette that resembles Andre. Wait... Is it secretly getting ... bigger?

item_weekraid_collection_1_4.name: Gold Statuette: Andre
item_weekraid_collection_1_4.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Andre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. His terrified looks are extremely well done. Someone even added this sentimental comment: "This would be perfect if someone places a gold Landbreaker axe right in front of it."

item_weekraid_collection_1_4_d.name: Gold Statuette: Andre
item_weekraid_collection_1_4_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Andre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. His terrified looks are extremely well done. Someone even added this sentimental comment: "This would be perfect if someone places a gold Landbreaker axe right in front of it."

item_wpnpotentialup_bp.name: Protocolized Weapon Pattern
item_wpnpotentialup_bp.decoDesc: The Arsenal Engineers are always recording operator weapon preferences and other expectations they have... The Protocol Pass is an attempt used by the Arsenal to boost weapon R&D efficiency in Endfield.

item_weekraid_collection_1_6_d.name: Specimen: Toolkit
item_weekraid_collection_1_6_d.decoDesc: A set of tools sealed in a jar. Muffled words can be heard when one presses the ear against it: "...go bandit-smashing with my hammer..." or "...these pipefaced rascals..."

item_weekraid_collection_1_7.name: Classified: Meat-Packing Plant
item_weekraid_collection_1_7.decoDesc: Classified records about a meat-packing plant. In some twisted aberrant, the meat-packing plant became a terrible lair that mass produces Aggeloi.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_9.name: Densolite Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_9.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though it appears dense and heavy, it is actually surprisingly light.

item_weekraid_collection_1_8.name: Classified: Worker Dorms
item_weekraid_collection_1_8.decoDesc: Classified records about the origins and construction of the Worker Dorms. From the very first shop, the very first clinic, and finally to all sorts of bread baked by Roman, these records describe the joys and sorrows of the crew mates.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_2.name: Twisted Mask Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_2.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. Upon closer inspection, the scars of combat that cover the fragment would suddenly turn blurry.

item_weekraid_collection_1_8_d.name: Classified: Worker Dorms
item_weekraid_collection_1_8_d.decoDesc: Classified records about the origins and construction of the Worker Dorms. From the very first shop, the very first clinic, and finally to all sorts of bread baked by Roman, these records describe the joys and sorrows of the crew mates.

item_weekraid_collection_1_9_d.name: Gold Statuette: Tata
item_weekraid_collection_1_9_d.decoDesc: A miniature model of Tata. Thanks to the influences of the Valley's Aberrants, it is fully clad in heavy armor plates and furnished with 6 auto-turrets and 4 jet propulsion nozzles.

item_weekraid_collection_2_1.name: Classified: Aburrey
item_weekraid_collection_2_1.decoDesc: Classified records about the hero named Aburrey. Her students remembered all of her classes. Most importantly, they remembered her sacrifice, her fight, and her lesson for the future.

item_weekraid_collection_2_2_d.name: Classified: Plan for Developing the Valleys
item_weekraid_collection_2_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records of plans for developing various valleys. The entire project starts with Valley I, Valley II, Valley III, Valley IV, Valley V, and more beyond. If things work according to plan, these production sites would be part of a network linked with Talos City, and become a powerful arm that stretches to the North.

item_weekraid_collection_2_4.name: Gold Statuette: Mark
item_weekraid_collection_2_4.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Mark holding a suppressant. The people's faith in the hero and his final will manifested the suppressant in this Protocol Space, time and time again.

item_weekraid_collection_2_5_d.name: Specimen: Originium Branch
item_weekraid_collection_2_5_d.decoDesc: A fresh branch of the Great Originium Oak sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, someone grafted a withered twig of Seš'qamam witchcraft to the Great Originium Oak. This act caused the once-dead tree to sprout again with life.

item_weekraid_collection_2_6.name: Specimen: Bombardment Beacon
item_weekraid_collection_2_6.decoDesc: An orbital bombardment guidance beacon sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, Dijiang has enough heavy ordnance to bombard any location on the planet.

item_weekraid_collection_3_1.name: Classified: The Pack
item_weekraid_collection_3_1.decoDesc: Classified records about the Pack. It includes the history and development of the Pack — starting with the shattering of warlord Jakub's ambitions, the splintering of the Landbreaker clans, and to the present day.

item_weekraid_collection_3_1_d.name: Classified: The Pack
item_weekraid_collection_3_1_d.decoDesc: Classified records about the Pack. It includes the history and development of the Pack — starting with the shattering of warlord Jakub's ambitions, the splintering of the Landbreaker clans, and to the present day.

item_weekraid_collection_3_2_d.name: Classified: Aggelos Forge
item_weekraid_collection_3_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records about the Aggelos Forge. The document seems to describe an aberrant version of some Originium Science Park experimental product. Artificial Aggeloi is a distant fantasy. Opening the forge only causes squealing pebbles to hop out of it.

wpn_pistol_0001.name: Peco 5
wpn_pistol_0001.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is designed by Endfield Arsenal Engineer Peco. Mastery of etched ammo and firearms is no longer a skill exclusive to the Sankta.

item_weekraid_collection_3_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Wulfgard
item_weekraid_collection_3_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Wulfgard. One could feel scorching heat while holding it. A pack of wolves holding guns and ammo in their jaws circle around him.

item_weekraid_collection_3_4_d.name: Gold Statuette: Drill Crawler
item_weekraid_collection_3_4_d.decoDesc: A scale model so intricate that people might think someone actually shrunk the actual machine to make this. "This old boy should've been the one to ram that blasted Ankhor open! This old boy is the REAL CHAMP!" ...And it also comes with a text-to-speech module.

item_weekraid_collection_4_1_d.name: Classified: Giant Weaponry
item_weekraid_collection_4_1_d.decoDesc: Classified records about weapon stashes at a certain location. When the inglorious conflict ended, mass-casualty weapons were either destroyed or vaulted away. Of course, there were a few exceptions.

item_weekraid_collection_6_4.name: Gold Statuette: Dijiang
item_weekraid_collection_6_4.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Dijiang. A small shard of Origocrust replaced the Protocol-Originium of the original. It is aligned vertically to point straight at the sky, and symbolizes the indomitable spirit of humanity.

item_weekraid_collection_4_2.name: Classified: Cathedral IV
item_weekraid_collection_4_2.decoDesc: Classified records about the new cathedral of the Cabal of Tranquility. In some twisted aberrant, massive ruins hidden beneath the surface of Valley IV seized the attention of the Cabal. And thus they raised a new cathedral at that place.

item_weekraid_collection_4_3.name: Gold Statuette: Yvonne
item_weekraid_collection_4_3.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Yvonne holding a vinyl between her fingers. The vinyl shares the same album cover that Yvonne showed you before, but the playlist sounds totally different. It felt as though the same musician has composed the music during a totally different time.

item_weekraid_collection_4_5.name: Specimen: Tube Professor
item_weekraid_collection_4_5.decoDesc: A miniature tube professor sealed in a jar. It seems to have some resemblance to Pocus... And strangely enough, it is shaking wildly in its jar.

item_weekraid_collection_4_6.name: Specimen: Astronomical Object
item_weekraid_collection_4_6.decoDesc: A fragment of an astronomical object sealed in a jar. Though ... the Fifth Child, the youngling, has fractured, it remains unblemished.

item_weekraid_collection_5_2_d.name: Classified: Final Will
item_weekraid_collection_5_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records about several wills. The words on the letters kept changing: "I never regretted joining the Security Bureau, baby sis..." In some twisted aberrant, people failed to contain the disaster quickly enough. The words of the dead echo upon these pieces of paper.

item_weekraid_collection_5_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Old Bombtail
item_weekraid_collection_5_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of a Tweety-Bomb. This one seems to have been in service for a while, since it is covered in rust and looks pretty exhausted. If it could talk, it would have plenty of stories to tell.

item_weekraid_collection_5_4_d.name: Gold Statuette: Crowe
item_weekraid_collection_5_4_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Crowe shrouded in hazefyre. Nobody knows why it showed up in the Protocol Space. The face of the statuette is a twisted grimace of sadness, denial, and rage.

item_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.name: Mystery Soda
item_wgslime_1_wgthorns_1_1.decoDesc: Pop it open and start chugging. Feel the fizz dance on your tongue, then give a satisfied burp. It's that simple.

item_weekraid_collection_5_5_d.name: Specimen: Arts Unit
item_weekraid_collection_5_5_d.decoDesc: An experimental Arts Unit sealed in a jar. According to the ideas of the Originium Science Park designers, this liquid Arts Unit can attach itself to the surface of an Aggelos and exert control over it.

item_weekraid_collection_5_6.name: Specimen: Blossom of Deathly Silence
item_weekraid_collection_5_6.decoDesc: A flower covered in dust sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, the Landbreakers completely occupied Valley IV for three hours before saturation bombardment turned the entire place into a lifeless ruin.

item_weekraid_collection_5_6_d.name: Specimen: Blossom of Deathly Silence
item_weekraid_collection_5_6_d.decoDesc: A flower covered in dust sealed in a jar. In some twisted aberrant, the Landbreakers completely occupied Valley IV for three hours before saturation bombardment turned the entire place into a lifeless ruin.

item_weekraid_collection_6_1_d.name: Classified: Rhodagn
item_weekraid_collection_6_1_d.decoDesc: Classified records about Rhodagn's life. They describe an actual past undistorted by the aberrant. Rhodagn fought battle after battle, crushed every contender with his heavy fists, and earned the right to bear the hazefyre generator upon his back.

item_weekraid_collection_6_2_d.name: Classified: Bonekrusher Civil War
item_weekraid_collection_6_2_d.decoDesc: Classified records about the Bonekrushers internal purge and the rise of Nefarith. They describe an actual past undistorted by the aberrant. Roarmaw, Old Witch, Hammersmith ... many tried to stop the rise of Nefarith. However, their weapons and even their bodies were cast into denstacks and have been burning ever since.

item_weekraid_collection_6_3_d.name: Gold Statuette: Perlica
item_weekraid_collection_6_3_d.decoDesc: A gold statuette of Perlica. It is exceptionally heavy for reasons unknown, though it might be an influence of the aberrant. The heavy responsibilities of the Supervisor are made manifest with this statuette.

item_weekraid_collection_6_6.name: Specimen: Blood Dust
item_weekraid_collection_6_6.decoDesc: The blood of the great nemesis sealed in a jar. The fluid has already seeped into the earth. This is but a warped and superficial fantasy. She walked into the light as humanity had long bled dry.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_10_d.name: Energized Densolite Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_10_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample was acquired from the surface of an animate Aggelos-like entity. Though exceptionally hard, it occasionally twists itself into spiral.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_11.name: Tactical Equipment Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_11.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was excised from the combat wraps often used by Landbreakers. It exhibits Æther energy levels that exceed the max readings of most instruments, yet somehow retains its original form.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_2_d.name: Twisted Mask Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_2_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment fell off a Bonekrusher's mask. Upon closer inspection, the scars of combat that cover the fragment would suddenly turn blurry.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_3_d.name: Rust Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_3_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It still gives off strange pulses of energy when held.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_4.name: Dark Rust Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_4.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It is covered by a black substance that constantly twitches and changes its location.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_4_d.name: Dark Rust Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_4_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample fell off the main body of an animate Aggelos-like entity. It is covered by a black substance that constantly twitches and changes its location.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_6_d.name: Tainted Crystal-Embedded Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_6_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This sample is a plant fragment shed by a fallen organism. In addition to bits of Originium crystal attachments, the sample is coated with a Blighted material that should not be there in the first place.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_7.name: Tubular Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_7.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. Analysis reveals that the fragment exhibits unusually high energy density.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_8.name: Tough Tubular Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_8.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. In addition to its unusually high energy density, the fragment also exhibits flickers of hazefyre that can be seen with the unaided eye.

item_weekraid_enemy_drop_8_d.name: Tough Tubular Fragment
item_weekraid_enemy_drop_8_d.decoDesc: A material sample that can be used in data analysis. This fragment was part of the soft tubular protrusions of Bonekrusher masks. In addition to its unusually high energy density, the fragment also exhibits flickers of hazefyre that can be seen with the unaided eye.

item_weekraid_gold.name: Aurylene Crystal
item_weekraid_gold.decoDesc: A glimmering Aurylene Crystal created through special means. It offers unique research values.

item_weekraid_key_4.name: Amberite Fragment
item_weekraid_key_4.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This sample resembles an amber-colored rock and was taken from the remains of an Effigy (Aggelos). Subjecting the sample to external impact causes the fragment to temporarily collapse into an amber-colored vortex before reverting to its original form.

item_weekraid_key_6.name: Refractorite Fragment
item_weekraid_key_6.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was taken from the remains of a Sentinel (Aggelos). Though covered by what seems to be scorch marks, no artificial temperature is hot enough to melt the fragment.

item_weekraid_key_6_d.name: Refractorite Fragment
item_weekraid_key_6_d.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was taken from the remains of a Sentinel (Aggelos). Though covered by what seems to be scorch marks, no artificial temperature is hot enough to melt the fragment.

item_weekraid_key_8.name: Unbreachable Crystal Fragment
item_weekraid_key_8.decoDesc: A material sample with many rare properties. This fragment was shed by a smooth, crystalline entity. No other material or tool could leave a mark on the sample. In fact, none of the attempts even made a sound.

item_weekraid_ore_1_2.name: Malformed Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_1_2.decoDesc: A sizable, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can give birth to exaggerated imaginations never thought of before.

item_weekraid_ore_1_3.name: Malformed Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_1_3.decoDesc: A large, dense, and dark colored crystal formation. Such materials usually arise when matter is subject to compressive forces generated by transformations of Protocol Space. It can also give birth to wild, twisted, yet superficial fantasies.

item_weekraid_ore_1_5.name: Rough Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_1_5.decoDesc: A sizable and dense crystal formation imbued with growth, power, and a dash of confusion... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.

item_weekraid_ore_1_6.name: Rough Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_1_6.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation imbued with depletion, despair, and a touch of death... It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Origins.

item_weekraid_ore_2_2.name: Common Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_2_2.decoDesc: A sizable and dense crystal formation. "The cold glance bears the weight to crush everything in sight." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Pressure.

wpn_lance_0009.name: Opero 77
wpn_lance_0009.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is personally designed by senior Endfield Arsenal Engineer Opero. It can be wielded effectively by even newly minted Endfield operators, thanks to its ergonomic designs.

item_weekraid_ore_3_3.name: Fine Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_3_3.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation. "Tunnel through the mountains! Ignite yourselves and leave the long night behind." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Conflagration.

item_weekraid_ore_4_1.name: Rare Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_4_1.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation. "And that was how steel and concrete sprouted from the ground. They become the framework of the land, the skeleton of Civilization." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.

item_weekraid_ore_4_2.name: Rare Nodule [M]
item_weekraid_ore_4_2.decoDesc: A sizable and dense crystal formation. "Blood and fresh grew forth to mend the gashes of the land." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Connection.

item_weekraid_ore_5_1.name: Precious Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_5_1.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation. "The answer was so close, just one jump away." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Leap.

item_weekraid_ore_5_3.name: Precious Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_5_3.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation. "Eons of barrenness burned to lead the uplifted ones forward." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Leap.

item_weekraid_ore_6_1.name: Sparkling Nodule [S]
item_weekraid_ore_6_1.decoDesc: A small and dense crystal formation. "The aberrants are derived from entities that rejected life." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.

item_weekraid_ore_6_3.name: Sparkling Nodule [L]
item_weekraid_ore_6_3.decoDesc: A large and dense crystal formation. "Here is the hazefyre that chokes the path. The malignance consuming Civilization has continued to spread." It is created by compressive forces generated by the Aberrant of Hazefyre.

item_weekraid_tech_1_1.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 1
item_weekraid_tech_1_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_weekraid_tech_1_2.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 2
item_weekraid_tech_1_2.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_weekraid_tech_1_9.name: Protocol Stabilizing Chip 9
item_weekraid_tech_1_9.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Protocol Stabilization" technology. The evolution of this Æther-affected Protocol Space is incomplete. Stabilizing it will reduce the possibility of sudden disasters and achieve the first step of exploration.

item_weekraid_tech_2_1.name: Container Expansion Chip 1
item_weekraid_tech_2_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_weekraid_tech_2_4.name: Container Expansion Chip 4
item_weekraid_tech_2_4.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_weekraid_tech_2_5.name: Container Expansion Chip 5
item_weekraid_tech_2_5.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_weekraid_tech_2_7.name: Container Expansion Chip 7
item_weekraid_tech_2_7.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Container Expansion" technology. "Increase the thickness of the lead containment layer for safety considerations... After all, nobody knows if the stored item would suddenly jump out and bite your hand."

item_weekraid_tech_3_1.name: Derangement Tolerance Chip 1
item_weekraid_tech_3_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Derangement Tolerance" technology. Please stick this "surface-mounting chip" on your temple. It will protect you against cognito interferences that might arise when the Protocol Space undergo changes.

item_weekraid_tech_4_1.name: Portable Explosives Chip 1
item_weekraid_tech_4_1.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Portable Explosives" technology. It is personally designed by an Arsenal Engineer to guarantee your firepower.

item_weekraid_tech_6_4.name: Charge Burst Chip
item_weekraid_tech_6_4.decoDesc: A chip storing data related to the "Charge Burst" technology. "This is quite a dangerous test. We're trying to use your weapon to 'activate' the Aberrant and annihilate the enemies."

item_wgshoal_1_grass_1_grass_2_1.name: Mini Sugar Painting
item_wgshoal_1_grass_1_grass_2_1.decoDesc: An extremely simple snack. For expatriates who cannot return home ... a quick fix of nostalgia can be acquired in the most simple of sweets.

item_wuling_detector_trchest_3.name: Keen Wuling Detector
item_wuling_detector_trchest_3.decoDesc:
A small detector furnished with Xiranite technology, giving it the ability to accurately locate metallic objects. The detector can thus be used to locate storage crates. 
Fresh off the production line! Look how it shimmers!

item_xiranite_powder.name: Xiranite
item_xiranite_powder.decoDesc: A novel Originium-based material acquired by fusing the mineral with Feranmut power. This material fuels life and prosperity in Wuling.

monthlycard_reward_r_1.name: Monthly Pass Exchange Cert
monthlycard_reward_r_1.decoDesc: Scan this with the Protosync and the Logistics Division will offer you tons of special perks, privileges, and services.

ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.name: Firewalker's Trail HH Permit
ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_1.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_3.name: Messenger Express HH Permit
ticketgacha_special_single_lt_1_0_3.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit.

ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_2.name: Spectral Splendor 10×Permit
ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_2.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_3.name: Messenger Express 10×Permit
ticketgacha_special_ten_lt_1_0_3.decoDesc: A special HR permit for headhunting operators who meet various unique requirements. Given the emergency of this request, this permit will inevitably expire after a certain time limit. NOTE: HR operators have spent entire weeks preparing this permit. Use it wisely.

wpn_claym_0003.name: Industry 0.1
wpn_claym_0003.decoDesc: A weapon commonly seen in the frontiers. No one knows who came up with the basic designs. This particular piece can be easily produced by common industrial machinery.

wpn_claym_0006.name: Former Finery
wpn_claym_0006.decoDesc: A high-end product of Northmarch Support Hub. This chain cutter was designed with older technology. Though no longer mass produced, the weapon continues to prove its reliability in the field.

wpn_claym_0008.name: Sundered Prince
wpn_claym_0008.decoDesc: A special limited-release weapon from the Witching Hour. The appearance of the greatsword is probably based on an ancient legend. It seems capable of ripping wails of anguish out of the realm of dreams.

wpn_claym_0009.name: Quencher
wpn_claym_0009.decoDesc: A standard greatsword made by Fort Forgefane. Although very few have mastered this weapon, the weapon is easy to wield and has been the most popular choice amongst raw recruits for many years.

wpn_claym_0010.name: Darhoff 7
wpn_claym_0010.decoDesc: One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is designed by Endfield Arsenal Engineer Darhoff. Its designs offer a viable option for those taking part in assault operations.

wpn_claym_0012.name: Finishing Call
wpn_claym_0012.decoDesc: A special Mieszko Industries weapon with a limited production run. This was the final design of the collaborative project pursued by the arms company and the Knights Major expert Cromwell.

wpn_claym_0014.name: Ancient Canal
wpn_claym_0014.decoDesc: A quality greatsword manufactured by Hongshan Swordmancers. When compared to other greatswords, this one is lighter but just as deadly.

wpn_funnel_0001.name: Hypernova Auto
wpn_funnel_0001.decoDesc: One of the advanced weaponry manufactured by Endfield for their operators. The Endfield arsenal adopted Andre's blueprints to create a drone capable of storing Arts so that they can be quickly cast in emergencies.

wpn_funnel_0005.name: Stanza of Memorials
wpn_funnel_0005.decoDesc: One of the strange-looking Arts units released by Witching Hour. Its counter-intuitive designs include a deliberately reduced Originium Arts compatibility just to highlight the dark logic of Ancient Teekaz witchcraft.

wpn_funnel_0010.name: Chivalric Virtues
wpn_funnel_0010.decoDesc: One of the Arts units developed by Mieszko Industries. The weapon features special D64 steel chassis and a suite of customizable modules. Its appearance reminds people of firework displays of knight majors from the past.

wpn_funnel_0014.name: OBJ Arts Identifier
wpn_funnel_0014.decoDesc: A standard weapon produced by Endfield Industries. Design is provided by the Creative Prototyping Team founded by Senior Arsenal Engineer Opero. Power is determined by the user's mastery in the Originium Arts.

wpn_lance_0008.name: Aggeloslayer
wpn_lance_0008.decoDesc: A standard-issue lance made by Fort Forgefane to arm the common soldiery. Furnished with an extremely sharp tip specifically designed for fighting the Aggeloi.

wpn_lance_0010.name: Valiant
wpn_lance_0010.decoDesc: A mid-tier product of Mieszko Industries. The lance is rare yet highly sought after, thanks to vintage designs that make it resemble a ballista bolt as well as its effective field performance.

wpn_pistol_0002.name: Howling Guard
wpn_pistol_0002.decoDesc: A mid-tier product of Mieszko Industries. This pistol is a perfect combination of vintage Lateran designs with modern industrial construction. A blue metallic coating gave the finishing touches for this unique work of art.

wpn_pistol_0003.name: Long Road
wpn_pistol_0003.decoDesc: A standard-issue firearm made by Fort Forgefane to arm the common soldiery. This weapon was extremely popular due to its simplified firing mechanism and incredible stopping power.

wpn_pistol_0004.name: Rational Farewell
wpn_pistol_0004.decoDesc: RAYTHEAN Industries developed this high energy pistol for frontiers use. Decent reliability in adverse environments makes this a standard-issue weapon amongst wildland explorers.

wpn_pistol_0009.name: Clannibal
wpn_pistol_0009.decoDesc: A special gun manufactured by RAYTHEAN Industries. This experimental weapon is extremely difficult to use. Only a limited number of prototypes were released to the arms market.

wpn_pistol_0012.name: OBJ Velocitous
wpn_pistol_0012.decoDesc: A standard weapon produced by Endfield Industries. Design is provided by the Creative Prototyping Team founded by Senior Arsenal Engineer Opero. The weapon is constructed using lightweight, practical, and durable materials.

wpn_sword_0007.name: Fortmaker
wpn_sword_0007.decoDesc: One of the weapons made by Fort Forgefane. The sword features traditional architecture that made it extremely durable and sturdy. The thick, heavy blade left countless scars upon the permafrost as the frontlines shifted with the times.

wpn_sword_0008.name: Contingent Measure
wpn_sword_0008.decoDesc: One of the advanced weaponry manufactured by Endfield for their operators. Minimalist modular architecture resulted in a lightweight weapon with excellent balance and handling. The blade itself is extremely durable.

wpn_sword_0011.name: Rapid Ascent
wpn_sword_0011.decoDesc: A high-end ornamental sword from Hongshan Swordmancers. The weapon is often used as an award for outstanding individuals. The name is finalized after an internal voting process in Hongshan Academy of Sciences.
